<!DOCTYPE html>

<head>

  <style>

    * { box-sizing: border-box; }

    html, body {

      margin: 0; padding: 0;

      width: 100%; height: 100%;

      overflow: hidden;

      font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;

      background-color: #03060c;

      perspective: 1200px;

      perspective-origin: 45% 50%;

    }

    /* ===== ABERTURA ANIMADA (tela de carregamento) ===== */

    .hb-intro { background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 40%, #0B1A2E 0%, #050A14 62%); }

    .hb-intro-grid { position: absolute; inset: 0; background-image: linear-gradient(rgba(34,211,238,0.07) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(34,211,238,0.07) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 38px 38px; mask-image: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%, #000 0%, transparent 70%); -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%, #000 0%, transparent 70%); animation: hbGridMove 6s linear infinite; }

    .hb-intro-sweep { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; height: 140px; top: -140px; background: linear-gradient(transparent, rgba(34,211,238,0.10), transparent); animation: hbSweep 2.6s ease-in-out infinite; }

    .hb-intro-tv { position: relative; width: 230px; height: 130px; border-radius: 16px; border: 2px solid #22D3EE; background: #02050A; box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(34,211,238,0.45), inset 0 0 24px rgba(34,211,238,0.18); animation: hbCrtOn 0.7s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both; }

    .hb-intro-tv::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: -14px; width: 70px; height: 4px; margin-left: -35px; border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(34,211,238,0.5); box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(34,211,238,0.7); }

    .hb-intro-screen { position: absolute; inset: 6px; border-radius: 11px; overflow: hidden; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #0B1626, #050A14); }

    .hb-intro-logo { font-weight: 800; font-size: 46px; color: #FB923C; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(249,115,22,0.9), 0 0 42px rgba(249,115,22,0.5); animation: hbPulse 1.4s ease-in-out infinite, hbGlitch 3.2s steps(1) infinite; }

    .hb-intro-bars { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 14px; display: flex; }

    .hb-intro-bars span { flex: 1; animation: hbBar 1.1s ease-in-out infinite; }

    .hb-intro-bars span:nth-child(1) { background: #F8FAFC; } .hb-intro-bars span:nth-child(2) { background: #FACC15; }

    .hb-intro-bars span:nth-child(3) { background: #22D3EE; } .hb-intro-bars span:nth-child(4) { background: #22C55E; }

    .hb-intro-bars span:nth-child(5) { background: #A78BFA; } .hb-intro-bars span:nth-child(6) { background: #F97316; }

    .hb-intro-bars span:nth-child(7) { background: #3B82F6; }

    .hb-intro-scan { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; height: 3px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.35); box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255,255,255,0.5); animation: hbScanY 1.8s linear infinite; }

    .hb-intro-title { font-weight: 800; font-size: 26px; color: #FB923C; text-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(249,115,22,0.55); animation: hbTitle 1.1s 0.35s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both; }

    .hb-intro-sub { margin-top: 10px; font-size: 11px; color: #67E8F9; letter-spacing: 0.18em; animation: hbFade 0.8s 0.9s both; }

    .hb-dots i { font-style: normal; animation: hbBlink 1.2s infinite; } .hb-dots i:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.2s; } .hb-dots i:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.4s; }

    .hb-intro-load { width: 200px; height: 4px; border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(148,163,184,0.18); overflow: hidden; animation: hbFade 0.6s 0.7s both; }

    .hb-intro-load span { display: block; width: 45%; height: 100%; border-radius: 4px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #F97316, #22D3EE); box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(34,211,238,0.7); animation: hbLoad 1.3s ease-in-out infinite; }

    @keyframes hbCrtOn { 0% { transform: scale(0.02, 0.02); opacity: 0; filter: brightness(3); } 45% { transform: scale(1, 0.02); opacity: 1; filter: brightness(3); } 100% { transform: scale(1, 1); opacity: 1; filter: brightness(1); } }

    @keyframes hbPulse { 0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); filter: brightness(1); } 50% { transform: scale(1.06); filter: brightness(1.25); } }

    @keyframes hbGlitch { 0%, 92%, 100% { transform: translateX(0); } 93% { transform: translateX(-3px); } 95% { transform: translateX(3px); } 97% { transform: translateX(-2px); } }

    @keyframes hbBar { 0%, 100% { opacity: 0.35; } 50% { opacity: 1; } }

    @keyframes hbScanY { 0% { top: -4px; } 100% { top: 100%; } }

    @keyframes hbTitle { 0% { opacity: 0; letter-spacing: 0.7em; filter: blur(6px); } 100% { opacity: 1; letter-spacing: 0.1em; filter: blur(0); } }

    @keyframes hbFade { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px); } 100% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }

    @keyframes hbBlink { 0%, 100% { opacity: 0.15; } 50% { opacity: 1; } }

    @keyframes hbLoad { 0% { transform: translateX(-110%); } 100% { transform: translateX(260%); } }

    @keyframes hbSweep { 0% { top: -140px; } 100% { top: 100%; } }

    @keyframes hbGridMove { 0% { background-position: 0 0; } 100% { background-position: 0 38px; } }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .hb-intro *, .hb-intro { animation-duration: 0.01s !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; } }

    @keyframes gentleWaveBreath {

      0%, 100% { transform: perspective(1200px) rotateY(2.2deg) rotateX(1deg) translate3d(0, 0px, 20px); }

      50% { transform: perspective(1200px) rotateY(1.5deg) rotateX(1.5deg) translate3d(0, -5px, 25px); }

    }

    .stark-screen-deep {

      transform: perspective(1200px) rotateY(14deg) rotateX(3deg) translate3d(0, 0px, 15px);

      transform-origin: 18% center;

      transition: all 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);

    }

    .stark-screen-focus-front {

      animation: gentleWaveBreath 5s ease-in-out infinite;

      transform-origin: center center;

      transition: all 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);

    @keyframes electricSurgePath {

      0% { stroke-dashoffset: 2800; opacity: 0; }

      5% { opacity: 1; }

      30% { opacity: 0; }

      100% { stroke-dashoffset: 0; opacity: 0; }

    }

    .electric-circuit-surge {

      stroke-dasharray: 600 2200;

      animation: electricSurgePath 10s linear infinite;

    @keyframes scanlineWave {

      100% { top: 200%; opacity: 0; }

    }

    .holo-scanline {

      position: absolute;

        radial-gradient(circle at 50% 25%, rgba(0, 242, 254, 0.08) 0%, transparent 60%),

        linear-gradient(to right, rgba(0, 242, 254, 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px),

      box-shadow: 0 4px 20px 0 rgba(0, 242, 254, 0.08), inset 0 0 14px 0 rgba(0, 242, 254, 0.12);

    .holo-glass-card:hover {

      border-color: #00f2fe;

      background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(3, 24, 48, 0.85) 0%, rgba(0, 242, 254, 0.14) 100%);

      box-shadow: 0 0 22px rgba(0, 242, 254, 0.5), inset 0 0 16px rgba(0, 242, 254, 0.25);

      transform: translateY(-3px) scale(1.015);

    }

    .holo-glass-card.active-hud {

      border-color: #f97316;

      background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(40, 15, 5, 0.85) 0%, rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.12) 100%);

      box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.6), inset 0 0 16px rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.25);

    }

    .yt-holder iframe { width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 0; pointer-events: auto; }

    .hud-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 6px; height: 6px; }

    .hud-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5); }

    .hud-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: rgba(0, 242, 254, 0.4); border-radius: 3px; }

    .hud-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.7); }

    .hb-logo { touch-action: manipulation; }

    .hb-mhead { display: none; }

    /* ===== CELULAR / TELA ESTREITA (o desktop não muda) ===== */

    @media (max-width: 820px) {

      html, body { height: auto; min-height: 100%; overflow-x: hidden; overflow-y: auto; }

      body { padding: 8px !important; padding-bottom: calc(8px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) !important; display: block !important; }

      #root { height: auto !important; }

      body { overflow: visible !important; } /* v4: deixa o topo e os botões "grudarem" (sticky) ao rolar */

      .hb-root { height: auto !important; min-height: 100vh; gap: 8px; justify-content: flex-start !important; }

      .hb-header { flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch !important; gap: 8px; }

      .hb-header h1 { font-size: 12px !important; line-height: 1.25; }

      .hb-headbtns { flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px !important; }

      .hb-headbtns button { padding: 8px 10px !important; font-size: 10px !important; }

      .hb-main { flex-direction: column !important; overflow: visible !important; margin: 4px 0 !important; gap: 12px !important; }

      .hb-stage { container-type: normal !important; display: flex !important; flex-direction: column !important; align-items: stretch !important;

                  padding: 0 !important; perspective: none !important; gap: 12px; }

      .hb-screen { transform: none !important; animation: none !important; box-shadow: none !important; width: 100% !important;

                   height: auto !important; max-height: none !important; aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; min-height: 220px; }

      .hb-pip { position: relative !important; inset: auto !important; bottom: auto !important; right: auto !important;

                width: 100% !important; height: auto !important; min-height: 280px; }

      .hb-pip .hb-expand { display: none !important; }

      .hb-pipbtn { position: relative !important; inset: auto !important; width: 100%; justify-content: center; padding: 12px !important; }

      .hb-side { width: 100% !important; height: auto !important; margin-left: 0 !important; }

      .hb-side[aria-hidden="true"] { display: none !important; }

      .hb-side > div { min-width: 0 !important; }

      .hb-main > button.absolute { display: none !important; }

      .hb-side > div, .hb-side > div > div { overflow: visible !important; flex: none !important; }

      .hb-chgrid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)) !important; overflow: visible !important; }

      .hb-chgrid > div { min-height: 120px; }

      .hb-adminwrap { padding: 0 !important; align-items: stretch !important; }

      .hb-admin { max-width: none !important; max-height: none !important; height: 100% !important; border-radius: 0 !important; border-width: 0 !important; }

      .hb-admin input, .hb-admin textarea, .hb-admin select { font-size: 16px !important; }

      .hb-admin > div:first-child { flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; align-items: flex-start !important; }

      .hb-admin > div:first-child > div:last-child { flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px !important; width: 100%; }

      .hb-admin > div:first-child > div:last-child > * { padding: 9px 10px !important; flex: 1 1 auto; text-align: center; }

      .hb-admin h3 { font-size: 12px !important; }

      .hb-admin form .flex.gap-2 { flex-direction: column; }

      .hb-admin form .flex.gap-2 > * { width: 100% !important; }

      .hb-admin div:has(> .shrink-0.ml-2) { flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; }

      .hb-admin div:has(> .shrink-0.ml-2) > :first-child { flex: 1 1 100%; min-width: 0; }

      .hb-admin .shrink-0.ml-2 { flex-wrap: wrap; margin-left: 0 !important; width: 100%; }

      .hb-admin .shrink-0.ml-2 > * { flex: 1 1 auto; padding: 9px 10px !important; }

      .hb-admin .grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) !important; }

      .hb-admin .truncate { white-space: normal; word-break: break-all; }

      /* --- topo mobile v3.9 --- */

      .hb-mhead { display: block; }

      .hb-header { display: none !important; }

      /* --- ajustes v3.8 (celular) --- */

      .hb-header p { display: none; }

      .hb-header h1 { font-size: 11px !important; }

      .hb-headbtns { gap: 5px !important; }

      .hb-headbtns button { padding: 6px 8px !important; font-size: 9px !important; }

      .hb-topbar { height: auto !important; min-height: 38px; padding: 6px 8px !important; gap: 8px; }

      .hb-topbar .hb-tabs { flex: 1 1 0; min-width: 0; padding-bottom: 2px; }

      .hb-topbar .hb-tabs button { padding: 5px 9px !important; font-size: 10px !important; }

      .hb-topbar > div:last-child button { padding: 5px 10px !important; font-size: 11px !important; }

      .hb-pricerow { flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; }

      .hb-pricerow > div { flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px 10px !important; }

      .hb-pricerow span { white-space: nowrap; }

      .hb-pricerow a { flex: 1 1 100%; text-align: center; padding: 12px !important; font-size: 12px !important; }

    }

  </style>

</head>

<body class="text-gray-100 cyber-grid min-h-screen flex flex-col justify-between p-3 selection:bg-[#00f2fe]/40 selection:text-white">

  <div id="root" class="w-full h-full"></div>

  <script type="text/babel">

    const { useState, useEffect, useRef } = React;

    // ===== DEEP LINK (?canal=X&item=Y) =====

    function readItemParamsFromUrl(channelsList) {

      try {

        const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);

        const cRaw = params.get("canal");

        const iRaw = params.get("item");

        if (cRaw === null && iRaw === null) return null;

        const ci = cRaw !== null ? parseInt(cRaw, 10) : 0;

        const ii = iRaw !== null ? parseInt(iRaw, 10) : 0;

        if (Number.isNaN(ci) || Number.isNaN(ii) || ci < 0 || ii < 0) return null;

        if (Array.isArray(channelsList) && channelsList.length) {

          if (!channelsList[ci]) return null;

          const vids = channelsList[ci].videos || [];

          return { ci, ii: vids[ii] ? ii : 0 };

        }

        return { ci, ii };

      } catch (e) {

        return null;

      }

    }

    function syncItemUrl(ci, ii, mode = "push", stateObj = null) {

      try {

        const url = new URL(window.location.href);

        if (ci === null || ii === null) {

          url.searchParams.delete("canal");

          url.searchParams.delete("item");

        } else {

          url.searchParams.set("canal", String(ci));

          url.searchParams.set("item", String(ii));

        }

        if (mode === "replace") {

          window.history.replaceState(stateObj !== null ? stateObj : window.history.state, "", url);

        } else {

          window.history.pushState(stateObj !== null ? stateObj : {}, "", url);

        }

      } catch (e) {}

    }

    const playHoloSound = (type = 'click') => {

      try {

        const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();

        const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();

        const gain = audioCtx.createGain();

        osc.connect(gain);

        gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);

        const now = audioCtx.currentTime;

        if (type === 'swap') {

          osc.type = 'sine';

          osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(360, now);

          osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(1180, now + 0.16);

          gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.12, now);

          gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.2);

          osc.start(now);

          osc.stop(now + 0.2);

        } else {

          osc.type = 'triangle';

          osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(850, now);

          osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(420, now + 0.07);

          gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.08, now);

          gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.08);

          osc.start(now);

          osc.stop(now + 0.08);

        }

      } catch (e) {}

    };

    function channelThumb(c) {

      const u = ((c.videos && c.videos[0] && c.videos[0].url) || "").trim();

      let m = u.match(/youtu\.be\/([\w-]{6,})/) || u.match(/[?&]v=([\w-]{6,})/) || u.match(/\/(?:shorts|embed)\/([\w-]{6,})/);

      if (u.match(/youtube\.com|youtu\.be/) && m) return "https://i.ytimg.com/vi/" + m[1] + "/hqdefault.jpg";

      if (/^data:image\//i.test(u) || /\.(png|jpe?g|webp|gif)($|\?)/i.test(u)) return u;

      return "";

    }

    function typeIcon(t) {

      return ({YOUTUBE:"▶",YOUTUBE_SHORTS:"📱",PDF:"📄",GOOGLE_DRIVE:"☁️",IMAGE:"🖼️",VIDEO:"🎞️",WEBSITE:"🌐"})[t] || "📺";

    }

    function parseOmniLink(rawUrl) {

      if (!rawUrl) return { type: 'UNKNOWN', cleanUrl: '', badge: 'STREAM' };

      let url = rawUrl.trim();

      if (/^data:image\//i.test(url)) return { type: 'IMAGE', cleanUrl: url, badge: 'IMAGEM HD' };

      if (/^data:video\//i.test(url)) return { type: 'VIDEO', cleanUrl: url, badge: 'VÍDEO MP4' };

      const iframeMatch = url.match(/src=["'](.*?)["']/);

      if (iframeMatch) url = iframeMatch[1];

      if (url.match(/\.pdf($|\?)/i) || (url.includes("drive.google.com") && url.includes(".pdf"))) {

        return {

          type: 'PDF',

          cleanUrl: url.includes("drive.google.com") ? url.replace(/\/view.*/, "/preview") : url,

          badge: 'DOCUMENTO PDF'

        };

      }

      if (url.includes("youtube.com/shorts/")) {

        const id = url.split("shorts/")[1].split("?")[0].split("/")[0];

        return {

          type: 'YOUTUBE_SHORTS',

          cleanUrl: `https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/${id}?autoplay=1&mute=1&loop=1&playlist=${id}&controls=1`,

          badge: 'SHORTS VERTICAL'

        };

      }

      if (url.includes("youtube.com") || url.includes("youtu.be")) {

        let id = "";

        if (url.includes("youtu.be/")) id = url.split("youtu.be/")[1].split("?")[0].split("&")[0];

        else if (url.includes("watch?v=")) id = url.split("watch?v=")[1].split("&")[0];

        else if (url.includes("/embed/")) id = url.split("/embed/")[1].split("?")[0].split("&")[0];

        return {

          type: 'YOUTUBE',

          cleanUrl: `https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/${id}?autoplay=1&mute=1&loop=1&playlist=${id}&controls=1`,

          badge: 'YOUTUBE HD'

        };

      }

      if (url.includes("drive.google.com")) {

        let driveUrl = url;

        if (url.includes("/view")) driveUrl = url.replace(/\/view.*/, "/preview");

        else if (!url.includes("/preview")) driveUrl = url.replace(/\/edit.*/, "/preview");

        return {

          type: 'GOOGLE_DRIVE',

          cleanUrl: driveUrl,

          badge: 'GOOGLE DRIVE'

        };

      }

      if (url.match(/\.(png|jpe?g|webp|gif|svg)($|\?)/i) || url.includes("susercontent.com/file/")) {

        return {

          type: 'IMAGE',

          cleanUrl: url,

          badge: 'IMAGEM HD'

        };

      }

      if (url.startsWith("blob:") || url.match(/\.(mp4|webm|ogg|mov)($|\?)/i) || url.includes("mixkit.co") || url.includes("pub-")) {

        return {

          type: 'VIDEO',

          cleanUrl: url,

          badge: 'VÍDEO MP4'

        };

      }

      return {

        type: 'WEBSITE',

        cleanUrl: url,

        badge: 'PORTAL / WEB'

      };

    }

    const SAFE_IMG_FALLBACK = "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1546776310-eef45dd6d63c?auto=format&fit=crop&w=600&q=80";

    // Lab 21b: miniatura "ao vivo" do site no card (so quando nao ha capa). Quadro 1024 px reduzido, sem toque, carrega so perto da tela.

    function SitePreview({ url, label, fallback }) {

      const boxRef = React.useRef(null);

      const [size, setSize] = React.useState({ w: 0, h: 0 });

      const [near, setNear] = React.useState(false);

      React.useEffect(() => {

        const el = boxRef.current; if (!el) return;

        const measure = () => setSize({ w: el.clientWidth, h: el.clientHeight });

        measure();

        let ro = null; try { ro = new ResizeObserver(measure); ro.observe(el); } catch (e) {}

        let io = null;

        try { io = new IntersectionObserver((en) => { if (en[0] && en[0].isIntersecting) { setNear(true); io.disconnect(); } }, { rootMargin: "300px" }); io.observe(el); } catch (e) { setNear(true); }

        return () => { if (ro) ro.disconnect(); if (io) io.disconnect(); };

      }, []);

      const W = 1024;

      const k = size.w ? size.w / W : 0;

      return (

        <div ref={boxRef} style={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, overflow: "hidden", background: "#0B1626" }}>

          <div style={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0 }}>{fallback}</div>

          {near && k > 0 ? (

            <iframe src={url} title={label || "site"} loading="lazy" tabIndex={-1} aria-hidden="true"

              sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin" referrerPolicy="no-referrer"

              style={{ position: "absolute", top: 0, left: 0, width: W, height: Math.ceil(size.h / k), border: 0, transform: "scale(" + k + ")", transformOrigin: "top left", pointerEvents: "none", background: "#fff" }} />

          ) : null}

        </div>

      );

    }

    function SafeImage({ src, alt, className, style }) {

      const [imgSrc, setImgSrc] = useState(src || SAFE_IMG_FALLBACK);

      useEffect(() => { setImgSrc(src || SAFE_IMG_FALLBACK); }, [src]);

      return (

        <img

          src={imgSrc}

          alt={alt || "Produto"}

          referrerPolicy="no-referrer"

          onError={() => setImgSrc(SAFE_IMG_FALLBACK)}

          style={style}

          className={className}

        />

      );

    }

    // ===== YOUTUBE: usa a API oficial para saber quando o vídeo acaba e controlar o som =====

    let ytApiPromise = null;

    function loadYTApi() {

      if (window.YT && window.YT.Player) return Promise.resolve(window.YT);

      if (!ytApiPromise) {

        ytApiPromise = new Promise((resolve) => {

          const prev = window.onYouTubeIframeAPIReady;

          window.onYouTubeIframeAPIReady = () => { if (prev) prev(); resolve(window.YT); };

          const tag = document.createElement("script");

          tag.src = "https://www.youtube.com/iframe_api";

          document.head.appendChild(tag);

        });

      }

      return ytApiPromise;

    }

    function YouTubePlayer({ videoId, isShorts, isMuted, autoAdvance, onEnded, onFail, onBlocked }) {

      const holder = useRef(null);

      const playerRef = useRef(null);

      const cb = useRef({});

      cb.current = { isMuted, autoAdvance, onEnded, onFail, onBlocked };

      useEffect(() => {

        let dead = false;

        const host = holder.current;

        const mount = document.createElement("div");

        host.innerHTML = "";

        host.appendChild(mount);

        loadYTApi().then((YT) => {

          if (dead) return;

          const vars = { autoplay: 1, mute: cb.current.isMuted ? 1 : 0, controls: 1, rel: 0, playsinline: 1 };

          if (String(location.protocol).indexOf("http") === 0) vars.origin = location.origin;

          playerRef.current = new YT.Player(mount, {

            host: "https://www.youtube-nocookie.com",

            videoId: videoId,

            width: "100%",

            height: "100%",

            playerVars: vars,

            events: {

              onReady: (e) => {

                if (cb.current.isMuted) e.target.mute();

                else { e.target.unMute(); e.target.setVolume(30); }

                e.target.playVideo();

                // abriu com som: se o navegador bloquear o som automático, cai sozinho para o mudo e segue tocando

                if (!cb.current.isMuted) {

                  const check = (n) => {

                    if (dead) return;

                    try {

                      const st = e.target.getPlayerState();

                      if (st === 1) return;

                      if (st === 3 && n < 3) { setTimeout(() => check(n + 1), 1500); return; }

                      if (st === -1 || st === 5 || st === 2) {

                        e.target.mute(); e.target.playVideo();

                        if (cb.current.onBlocked) cb.current.onBlocked();

                      }

                    } catch (err) {}

                  };

                  setTimeout(() => check(0), 1800);

                }

              },

              onStateChange: (e) => {

                if (e.data === 0) {

                  if (cb.current.autoAdvance) cb.current.onEnded();

                  else { e.target.seekTo(0); e.target.playVideo(); }

                }

              },

              onError: () => { if (cb.current.onFail) cb.current.onFail(); }

            }

          });

        });

        return () => {

          dead = true;

          try { if (playerRef.current && playerRef.current.destroy) playerRef.current.destroy(); } catch (err) {}

          playerRef.current = null;

          host.innerHTML = "";

        };

      }, [videoId]);

      useEffect(() => {

        const pl = playerRef.current;

        if (!pl || !pl.mute) return;

        try { if (isMuted) pl.mute(); else { pl.unMute(); pl.setVolume(30); } } catch (err) {}

      }, [isMuted]);

      return (

        <div

          ref={holder}

          className={`yt-holder ${isShorts ? 'w-[320px] h-full shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(249,115,22,0.4)] rounded-xl overflow-hidden' : 'w-full h-full'}`}

        />

      );

    }

    function HtmlVideo({ src, isMuted, autoAdvance, onEnded, onBlocked }) {

      const ref = useRef(null);

      useEffect(() => {

        const v = ref.current;

        if (!v) return;

        v.volume = 0.3; v.muted = isMuted;

        if (!isMuted) {

          const p = v.play();

          if (p && p.catch) p.catch(() => { v.muted = true; v.play().catch(() => {}); if (onBlocked) onBlocked(); });

        }

      }, [isMuted, src]);

      return (

        <video ref={ref} src={src} autoPlay controls muted={isMuted} playsInline loop={!autoAdvance} onEnded={onEnded} className="w-full h-full object-contain bg-black" />

      );

    }

    function OmniScreenRenderer({ videoUrl, title, isMuted, autoAdvance, onVideoEnded, onFail, onBlocked }) {

      if (!videoUrl) return null;

      const parsed = parseOmniLink(videoUrl);

      if (parsed.type === 'YOUTUBE' || parsed.type === 'YOUTUBE_SHORTS') {

        const ytId = ((parsed.cleanUrl.match(/\/embed\/([\w-]+)/) || [])[1]) || "";

        if (ytId) {

          return (

            <div className="w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center bg-black">

              <YouTubePlayer videoId={ytId} isShorts={parsed.type === 'YOUTUBE_SHORTS'} isMuted={isMuted} autoAdvance={autoAdvance} onEnded={onVideoEnded} onFail={onFail} onBlocked={onBlocked} />

            </div>

          );

        }

        return (

          <div className="w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center bg-black">

            <iframe

              className={`border-0 pointer-events-auto ${parsed.type === 'YOUTUBE_SHORTS' ? 'w-[320px] h-full shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(249,115,22,0.4)] rounded-xl' : 'w-full h-full'}`}

              src={parsed.cleanUrl}

              title={title}

              allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share"

              referrerPolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin"

              allowFullScreen

            />

          </div>

        );

      }

      if (parsed.type === 'GOOGLE_DRIVE') {

        return <iframe className="w-full h-full border-0 pointer-events-auto" src={parsed.cleanUrl} title={title} allow="autoplay; fullscreen" allowFullScreen />;

      }

      if (parsed.type === 'PDF') {

        return (

          <div className="w-full h-full bg-slate-900 overflow-auto hud-scroll p-1 flex flex-col">

            <iframe src={`${parsed.cleanUrl}#toolbar=1&navpanes=0`} title={title} className="w-full h-full border-0 rounded-lg flex-1" />

          </div>

        );

      }

      if (parsed.type === 'VIDEO') {

        return <HtmlVideo src={parsed.cleanUrl} isMuted={isMuted} autoAdvance={autoAdvance} onEnded={onVideoEnded} onBlocked={onBlocked} />;

      }

      if (parsed.type === 'IMAGE') {

        return (

          <div className="w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center bg-black overflow-hidden relative">

            <SafeImage src={parsed.cleanUrl} alt={title} className="w-full h-full object-contain p-2 hover:scale-105 transition duration-500" />

          </div>

        );

      }

      return (

        <div className="w-full h-full bg-slate-950 overflow-auto hud-scroll relative">

          <iframe src={parsed.cleanUrl} title={title} className="w-full h-full min-h-[600px] border-0" sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-popups allow-forms" />

        </div>

      );

    }

    // ===== PONTE COM O CATÁLOGO v4: produtos viram ANÚNCIOS do monitor menor =====

    const brlCat = (v) => (+v > 0 ? "R$ " + (+v).toFixed(2).replace(".", ",") : "Consulte o Preço");

    // ENDEREÇO DOS DADOS: o site que guarda só canais.json e catalogo.json. Para trocar de site, mude só esta linha.

    const DATA_URL = "./";

    function catalogToAds(data) {

      const list0 = Array.isArray(data) ? data : (data && data.P) || [];

      // Lab 24b: se o arquivo for no formato novo (anuncios.json: itens com "link"), usa o leitor novo; itens sem nome nem id (lixo) saem

      if (list0.some((x) => x && (x.link || x.url) && !x.n)) return linksToAds(list0);

      const list = list0.filter((p) => p && (p.n || p.id));

      const wa = String((data && data.cfg && data.cfg.wa) || "").replace(/\D/g, "");

      return list.map((p) => {

        const media = (Array.isArray(p.media) ? p.media : [])

          .filter((m) => m && m.src)

          .map((m) => ({ t: m.t === "vid" ? "vid" : "img", src: m.src }));

        const firstImg = media.find((m) => m.t === "img");

        const benefits = String(p.b || "").split("\n").map((x) => x.trim()).filter(Boolean);

        const pct = p.o > p.p && p.p > 0 ? Math.round((1 - p.p / p.o) * 100) : 0;

        const comum = p.tipo === "comum";

        const link = comum

          ? (wa ? `https://wa.me/${wa}?text=${encodeURIComponent("Olá! Tenho interesse no produto: " + p.n)}` : (p.l || "#"))

          : (p.l || "#");

        return {

          id: "AD_" + p.id,

          title: p.n,

          wa,

          media,

          offer: {

            title: p.n,

            priceOld: p.o > p.p ? brlCat(p.o) : "",

            priceCurrent: brlCat(p.p),

            discount: pct ? `-${pct}%` : "",

            sold: p.sd || "",

            rating: "",

            badge: p.bd || "",

            cta: p.cta || "",

            affiliateLink: link,

            thumbImg: (firstImg && firstImg.src) || SAFE_IMG_FALLBACK,

            features: benefits.length ? benefits.slice(0, 4) : ["Produto do catálogo Homem_Bruto"]

          }

        };

      });

    }

    // ===== Lab 24: anuncios.json (leve) = so links + campos opcionais. Substitui o catalogo.json pesado (que fica de reserva) =====

    function parseBRLn(v) {

      const t = String(v || "").replace(/[^\d,.]/g, "");

      if (!t) return 0;

      const n = parseFloat(t.indexOf(",") >= 0 ? t.replace(/\./g, "").replace(",", ".") : t);

      return isFinite(n) ? n : 0;

    }

    function linksToAds(data) {

      const list = Array.isArray(data) ? data : (data && data.anuncios) || [];

      const out = [];

      list.forEach((x, n) => {

        const link = String((x && (x.link || x.url)) || "").trim();

        if (!link) return;

        const m = link.match(/#\/p\/([^/?#]+)/);

        const slug = String(x.id || (m && m[1]) || ("a" + n)).replace(/^AD_/, "");

        let host = ""; try { host = new URL(link).hostname.replace(/^www\./, ""); } catch (e) {}

        const pretty = slug.replace(/[-_]+/g, " ").replace(/\b\w/g, (c) => c.toUpperCase());

        const title = String(x.titulo || x.title || "").trim() || pretty;

        const capa = String(x.capa || "").trim();

        const preco = String(x.preco || "").trim();

        const antigo = String(x.precoAntigo || "").trim();

        let desc = String(x.desconto || "").trim();

        if (!desc && parseBRLn(antigo) > parseBRLn(preco) && parseBRLn(preco) > 0) desc = "-" + Math.round((1 - parseBRLn(preco) / parseBRLn(antigo)) * 100) + "%";

        out.push({

          id: "AD_" + slug, title, page: link, wa: "",

          media: capa ? [{ t: "img", src: capa }] : [],

          offer: {

            title, priceCurrent: preco, priceOld: antigo, discount: desc, sold: String(x.vendidos || "").trim(), rating: "",

            badge: String(x.selo || "").trim(), cta: String(x.cta || "").trim() || "VER ANÚNCIO", affiliateLink: link,

            thumbImg: capa || SAFE_IMG_FALLBACK, features: [], sub: String(x.sub || "").trim(), local: String(x.local || "").trim(), host

          }

        });

      });

      return out;

    }

    // card completo (estilo vitrine): capa OU miniatura viva da pagina; selo, desconto, titulo, preco, "no Pix", local. Tudo opcional.

    function AdCard({ a, onClick }) {

      const o = a.offer;

      const capa = a.media && a.media[0] && a.media[0].src;

      const ph = (<div className="w-full h-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-900 to-black" style={{ color: "#FB923C", textAlign: "center", padding: 6 }}>

        <span style={{ fontSize: 30 }}>🛍</span>

        {o.host ? <span className="font-mono" style={{ fontSize: 9, color: "#94A3B8" }}>{o.host}</span> : null}

      </div>);

      return (

        <button type="button" onClick={onClick}

          style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", width: "100%", aspectRatio: "9 / 16", padding: 0, borderRadius: 14, overflow: "hidden", border: "1px solid #F97316", background: "#0B1626", cursor: "pointer", textAlign: "left" }}>

          <div style={{ position: "relative", width: "100%", flex: "1 1 0", minHeight: 0, background: "#050A14", overflow: "hidden" }}>

            {capa ? <SafeImage src={capa} alt={a.title} className="w-full h-full object-cover" /> : (a.page ? <SitePreview url={a.page} label={a.title} fallback={ph} /> : ph)}

            {o.discount ? <span className="font-mono" style={{ position: "absolute", top: 0, right: 0, padding: "3px 8px", fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 800, background: "#FEE2E2", color: "#DC2626", borderBottomLeftRadius: 8, zIndex: 2 }}>{o.discount}</span> : null}

          </div>

          <div style={{ padding: "9px 10px 11px", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 6, flex: "0 0 auto" }}>

            <div className="font-hud font-bold" style={{ fontSize: 12, lineHeight: 1.3, color: "#fff", display: "-webkit-box", WebkitLineClamp: 2, WebkitBoxOrient: "vertical", overflow: "hidden", wordBreak: "break-word" }}>

              {o.badge ? <span className="font-mono" style={{ display: "inline-block", marginRight: 5, padding: "1px 5px", borderRadius: 4, fontSize: 9, fontWeight: 800, background: "#F97316", color: "#1A0A00", verticalAlign: "1px" }}>{o.badge}</span> : null}

              {a.title}

            </div>

            {o.priceCurrent ? (

              <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "baseline", gap: 6, flexWrap: "wrap", marginTop: "auto" }}>

                <span className="font-hud font-extrabold" style={{ fontSize: 16, color: "#FB923C" }}>{o.priceCurrent}</span>

                {o.priceOld ? <span className="font-mono" style={{ fontSize: 10, color: "#64748B", textDecoration: "line-through" }}>{o.priceOld}</span> : null}

                {o.sub ? <span className="font-mono" style={{ fontSize: 10, color: "#FB923C" }}>{o.sub}</span> : null}

              </div>

            ) : <div className="font-mono" style={{ marginTop: "auto", fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 800, letterSpacing: "0.08em", color: "#FB923C" }}>{o.cta || "VER ANÚNCIO"} ›</div>}

            {o.local ? <div className="font-mono" style={{ fontSize: 10, color: "#94A3B8" }}>📍 {o.local}</div> : null}

          </div>

        </button>

      );

    }

    function AdMedia({ item, fallback, alt }) {

      if (item && item.t === "vid") {

        return <video key={item.src.slice(-40)} src={item.src} autoPlay muted loop playsInline className="w-full h-full object-contain" style={{ background: "#000" }} />;

      }

      const src = (item && item.src) || fallback;

      return (

        <div style={{ position: "relative", width: "100%", height: "100%", overflow: "hidden", background: "#050A14" }}>

          <SafeImage src={src} alt="" className="w-full h-full object-cover" style={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, filter: "blur(18px) brightness(0.55)", transform: "scale(1.2)" }} />

          <SafeImage src={src} alt={alt} className="w-full h-full object-contain" style={{ position: "relative", zIndex: 1 }} />

        </div>

      );

    }

    // ===== MOBILE v4 (etapa 1): home de canais, feed em linhas, visualizadores, anúncio em pé e ofertas =====

    // Só aparece em tela estreita (<= 820px). O desktop continua com o App original, sem mudanças.

    // Regra de ouro: vídeo 16:9 = palco largo (gira para paisagem). Todo o resto = palco em pé 9:16.

    function itemKind(url) {

      const t = parseOmniLink(url || "").type;

      if (t === "YOUTUBE" || t === "VIDEO") return "video";

      if (t === "YOUTUBE_SHORTS") return "short";

      if (t === "IMAGE") return "image";

      if (t === "PDF") return "pdf";

      return "site";

    }

    const KIND_LABEL = { video: "VÍDEO", short: "SHORT", image: "IMAGEM", site: "SITE", pdf: "PDF" };

    const KIND_TAB = { video: "VÍDEOS", short: "SHORTS", image: "IMAGENS", site: "SITES", pdf: "PDFS" };

    const itemThumb = (url) => channelThumb({ videos: [{ url: url }] });

    function Ico({ size = 20, children }) {

      return (

        <svg width={size} height={size} viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.75" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">{children}</svg>

      );

    }

    // ---------- CHAT (micro blog, só leitura no site; texto simples: "DD/MM/AAAA HH:MM | AUTOR | mensagem") ----------

    // Lab 25: sempre do mais novo para o mais antigo (pela data/hora de cada linha), seja qual for a ordem no arquivo

    function parseChat(txt) {

      const ts = (w) => { const m = String(w || "").match(/(\d{1,2})\/(\d{1,2})\/(\d{4})(?:\s+(\d{1,2}):(\d{2}))?/); return m ? new Date(+m[3], +m[2] - 1, +m[1], +(m[4] || 0), +(m[5] || 0)).getTime() : -1; };

      const arr = String(txt || "").split(/\r?\n/).map((l) => l.trim()).filter(Boolean).map((l, i) => {

        const p = l.split("|").map((x) => x.trim());

        let m;

        if (p.length >= 3) m = { when: p[0], who: p[1], text: p.slice(2).join(" | ") };

    function MobileTV({ channels, ads, isMuted, setIsMuted, onBlocked, autoPlay, setAutoPlay, holdSec, onAdmin, chatTxt }) {

        if (!d) return null;

      };

        const h = Math.floor(m / 60); if (h < 24) return " · há " + h + " h";

        const d = Math.floor(h / 24); if (d < 30) return " · há " + d + (d === 1 ? " dia" : " dias");

        const mo = Math.floor(d / 30); if (mo < 12) return " · há " + mo + (mo === 1 ? " mês" : " meses");

      };

      const mixAll = (() => {

        const dated = [], byCh = {};

      const advance = (dir) => {

      if (!ch) return null;

        const kindsPresent = [];

        const base = mixAll.filter((e) => mixFilter === "all" || e.kind === mixFilter);

        const isTall = (e) => !!e.ad || (e.kind !== "video" && e.kind !== "site");

        const adList = mixFilter === "all" ? ads.slice() : [];

        const q = [];

        let adPos = 0;

        base.forEach((e, n) => {

          q.push(e);

          if (adList.length && (n + 1) % 6 === 0) {

            q.push({ ad: adList[adPos % adList.length] }); adPos++;

            if (adList.length > 1) { q.push({ ad: adList[adPos % adList.length] }); adPos++; }

          }

        });

        const rows = [];

        const rest = q.slice();

        while (rest.length) {

          const e = rest.shift();

          if (!isTall(e)) { rows.push({ t: e.kind === "site" ? "sq" : "wide", e }); continue; }

          let j = -1;

          for (let k = 0; k < Math.min(rest.length, 3); k++) { if (isTall(rest[k])) { j = k; break; } }

          if (j >= 0) { rows.push({ t: "pair", list: [e, rest.splice(j, 1)[0]] }); }

          else if (adList.length > 1 || (adList.length === 1 && !e.ad)) {

            let a = adList[adPos % adList.length]; adPos++;

            if (e.ad && a.id === e.ad.id) { a = adList[adPos % adList.length]; adPos++; }

            rows.push({ t: "pair", list: [e, { ad: a }] });

          } else rows.push({ t: "pair", list: [e] });

        }

            style={{ position: "relative", width: "100%", aspectRatio: "9 / 16", padding: 0, borderRadius: 14, overflow: "hidden", border: "1px solid #F97316", background: "#0B1626", cursor: "pointer", textAlign: "left" }}>

            <AdMedia item={(a.media.find((x) => x.t !== "vid")) || a.media[0]} fallback={a.offer.thumbImg} alt={a.title} />

            {a.offer.badge ? tag(a.offer.badge, true) : null}

            <div style={{ position: "absolute", left: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0, padding: "26px 10px 10px", background: "linear-gradient(transparent, rgba(0,0,0,0.9))" }}>

              <div className="font-hud font-bold" style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "#fff", lineHeight: 1.25, marginBottom: 4 }}>{a.title}</div>

              <div className="font-hud font-extrabold" style={{ fontSize: 15, color: "#FDBA74" }}>{a.offer.priceCurrent}</div>

            </div>

          </button>

        );

        const cell = (e, ratio, tagTxt) => (

          <div key={"c" + e.ci + "-" + e.ii}>

            <button type="button" onClick={() => openItem(e.ci, e.ii, "mix")}

              style={{ position: "relative", display: "block", width: "100%", aspectRatio: ratio, padding: 0, borderRadius: 14, overflow: "hidden", border: "1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.4)", background: "#0B1626", cursor: "pointer", textAlign: "left" }}>

              {thumbBox(e)}

              {tag(tagTxt)}

            </button>

            {capTitle(e.label, meta(e), e.desc, () => openItem(e.ci, e.ii, "mix"))}

          </div>

        );

        const mixChipsBar = (

          <div style={{ padding: "10px 12px 8px", background: "#050A14", borderBottom: "1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.16)" }}>

            <div className="hud-scroll" style={{ display: "flex", overflowX: "auto", paddingBottom: 4 }}>

              <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, margin: "0 auto" }}>

                {chipMix("all", "TUDO")}

                {kindsPresent.map((k) => chipMix(k, KIND_TAB[k]))}

                {ads.length ? chipMix("ofertas", "OFERTAS", true, () => go("offers")) : null}

              </div>

            </div>

          </div>

        );

        return (

          <div style={{ minHeight: "100vh", paddingBottom: 24 }}>

            {topHeader(mixChipsBar)}

            <div style={{ padding: "12px 12px 0" }}>

                {rows.map((r, ri) => {

                  if (r.t === "wide") return <div key={"w" + ri}>{cell(r.e, "16 / 9", "VÍDEO · 16:9")}</div>;

                  if (r.t === "sq") return <div key={"s" + ri}>{cell(r.e, "1 / 1", "SITE · 1:1")}</div>;

                  return (

                    <div key={"p" + ri} style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr))", gap: 12, alignItems: "start" }}>

                      {r.list.map((e) => e.ad ? adCard(e.ad) : cell(e, "9 / 16", KIND_LABEL[e.kind]))}

                    </div>

                  );

                })}

                {!rows.length && <p className="font-mono" style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "#64748B", textAlign: "center", padding: "30px 0" }}>Nada por aqui ainda.</p>}

              </div>

            </div>

          </div>

        );

      }

      // ---------- NOSSA SALA (Rodrigo & Cláudia; leitura) ----------

      if (view === "sala") {

        const msgs = parseChat(chatTxt);

        const isCla = (w) => /cl[aá]ud/i.test(w || "");

        const linkify = (t) => String(t).split(/(https?:\/\/[^\s]+)/g).map((p, i) => /^https?:\/\//.test(p)

          ? <a key={i} href={p} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" style={{ color: "#67E8F9", textDecoration: "underline", wordBreak: "break-all" }}>{p}</a>

          : <span key={i}>{p}</span>);

        let lastDay = "";

        const last = msgs.length ? msgs[0] : null;

        return (

          <div style={{ minHeight: "100vh", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column" }}>

            {subHeader("NOSSA SALA", "RODRIGO & CLÁUDIA · " + msgs.length + (msgs.length === 1 ? " MENSAGEM" : " MENSAGENS"), () => { if (stackRef.current.length > 1) { try { window.history.back(); return; } catch (e) {} } navReplace("mix"); }, "orange")}

            <div style={{ padding: "14px 12px 0" }}>

              <div style={{ border: "1px solid rgba(249,115,22,0.35)", background: "rgba(249,115,22,0.07)", borderRadius: 14, padding: "10px 12px" }}>

                <div className="font-hud font-bold" style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#FB923C", letterSpacing: "0.06em" }}>BEM-VINDO À NOSSA SALA</div>

                <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#CBD5E1", lineHeight: 1.45, marginTop: 4 }}>Aqui o Rodrigo e a Cláudia conversam sobre a TV. Só nós dois escrevemos; você acompanha tudo por aqui.</div>

              </div>

            </div>

            <div style={{ flex: 1, padding: "12px 12px 28px", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 8 }}>

              {!msgs.length && <p className="font-mono" style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "#64748B", textAlign: "center", padding: "30px 0" }}>A sala ainda está vazia.</p>}

              {msgs.map((m, i) => {

                const cla = isCla(m.who);

                const day = (m.when || "").split(" ")[0];

                const hour = (m.when || "").split(" ")[1] || "";

                const sep = day && day !== lastDay;

                if (day) lastDay = day;

                return (

                  <React.Fragment key={i}>

                    {sep ? <div className="font-mono" style={{ alignSelf: "center", fontSize: 10, color: "#94A3B8", letterSpacing: "0.1em", padding: "6px 10px", border: "1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.25)", borderRadius: 999, marginTop: 6 }}>{day}</div> : null}

                    <div style={{ alignSelf: cla ? "flex-start" : "flex-end", maxWidth: "86%", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", alignItems: cla ? "flex-start" : "flex-end" }}>

                      <div className="font-mono" style={{ fontSize: 9, fontWeight: 800, letterSpacing: "0.08em", color: cla ? "#C4B5FD" : "#FDBA74", marginBottom: 3 }}>{(m.who || (cla ? "CLÁUDIA" : "RODRIGO")).toUpperCase()}{hour ? " · " + hour : ""}</div>

                      <div style={{ padding: "9px 12px", borderRadius: cla ? "4px 16px 16px 16px" : "16px 4px 16px 16px", background: cla ? "rgba(167,139,250,0.14)" : "rgba(249,115,22,0.16)", border: "1px solid " + (cla ? "rgba(167,139,250,0.45)" : "rgba(249,115,22,0.5)"), color: "#F1F5F9", fontSize: 14, lineHeight: 1.4, overflowWrap: "anywhere" }}>{linkify(m.text)}</div>

                    </div>

                  </React.Fragment>

                );

              })}

              {last && last.when ? <div className="font-mono" style={{ alignSelf: "center", fontSize: 9, color: "#64748B", letterSpacing: "0.1em", marginTop: 10 }}>ÚLTIMA ATUALIZAÇÃO · {last.when}</div> : null}

            </div>

          </div>

        );

      }

      // ---------- 1. HOME: CANAIS ----------

      if (view === "home") {

        const selCh = homeSel >= 0 && channels[homeSel] ? channels[homeSel] : null;

        const groups = {};

        channels.forEach((c, i) => {

          const k = String(c.category || "CANAIS").toUpperCase();

          (groups[k] = groups[k] || []).push({ c, i });

        });

        return (

          <div style={{ minHeight: "100vh", paddingBottom: 24 }}>

            {topBar}

            {tabsBar}

                <span className="font-mono" style={{ fontSize: 10, color: "#94A3B8" }}>{selCh ? "NO CANAL: " + (selCh.videos || []).length : "TOTAL: " + channels.length}</span>

              </div>

              <div style={{ position: "relative", marginTop: 14, zIndex: 31 }}>

                {homeOpen && <div onClick={() => setHomeOpen(false)} style={{ position: "fixed", inset: 0, zIndex: 30 }} />}

                <button type="button" aria-expanded={homeOpen} onClick={() => { playHoloSound("click"); setHomeOpen(!homeOpen); }} className="font-mono"

                  style={{ position: "relative", zIndex: 31, width: "100%", height: 48, borderRadius: 12, border: "1px solid #22D3EE", background: "#0B1626", color: "#fff", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 10, padding: "0 14px", fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 12, letterSpacing: "0.04em", textAlign: "left", cursor: "pointer" }}>

                  <span style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, whiteSpace: "nowrap", overflow: "hidden", textOverflow: "ellipsis" }}>{selCh ? selCh.title + " · " + (selCh.videos || []).length + ((selCh.videos || []).length === 1 ? " item" : " itens") : "ESCOLHA O CANAL"}</span>

                  <Ico><polyline points="6 9 12 15 18 9"></polyline></Ico>

                </button>

                {homeOpen && (

                    {[{ title: "TODOS OS CANAIS", n: channels.length + " canais", i: -1 }].concat(channels.map((c, i) => ({ title: c.title, n: (c.videos || []).length + ((c.videos || []).length === 1 ? " item" : " itens"), i }))).map((r) => (

                      <button key={r.i} type="button" onClick={() => { playHoloSound("click"); setHomeSel(r.i); setHomeOpen(false); }} className="font-mono"

                        style={{ width: "100%", minHeight: 48, display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 12, padding: "0 14px", border: 0, borderBottom: "1px solid #16233A", background: homeSel === r.i ? "rgba(34,211,238,0.10)" : "transparent", color: "#fff", textAlign: "left", cursor: "pointer" }}>

                        <span style={{ flex: "0 0 18px", width: 18, height: 18, boxSizing: "border-box", borderRadius: 9, border: "2px solid " + (homeSel === r.i ? "#22D3EE" : "#475569"), background: homeSel === r.i ? "#22D3EE" : "transparent" }}></span>

                        <span style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 800, letterSpacing: "0.04em" }}>{r.title}</span>

                        <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: "#94A3B8" }}>{r.n}</span>

                      </button>

                    ))}

                  </div>

                )}

              </div>

              {selCh ? (

                <div style={{ marginTop: 18, display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr))", gap: 12, alignItems: "start" }}>

                  {(selCh.videos || []).map((v, ii) => {

                    const k = itemKind(v.url);

                    const ratio = k === "video" ? "16 / 9" : k === "site" ? "1 / 1" : "9 / 16";

                    return (

                      <div key={ii}>

                        <button type="button" onClick={() => openItem(homeSel, ii, "home")}

                          style={{ position: "relative", width: "100%", aspectRatio: ratio, padding: 0, borderRadius: 14, overflow: "hidden", border: "1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.4)", background: "#0B1626", cursor: "pointer", textAlign: "left", display: "block" }}>

                          {thumbBox(v)}

                          {tag(KIND_LABEL[k] + (k === "video" ? " · 16:9" : k === "site" ? " · 1:1" : ""))}

                        </button>

                        {capTitle(v.label, KIND_LABEL[k], v.desc, () => openItem(homeSel, ii, "home"))}

                      </div>

                    );

                  })}

                  {!(selCh.videos || []).length && <p className="font-mono" style={{ gridColumn: "1 / -1", fontSize: 11, color: "#64748B", textAlign: "center", padding: "30px 0" }}>Nenhum item neste canal.</p>}

                </div>

              ) : null}

              {!selCh && Object.keys(groups).map((g) => (

                <div key={g} style={{ marginTop: 20 }}>

                  <div className="font-mono" style={{ fontSize: 10, letterSpacing: "0.14em", color: "#94A3B8", marginBottom: 10 }}>— {g}</div>

                  <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr))", gap: 12 }}>

                    {groups[g].map(({ c, i }) => {

                      const first = (c.videos || [])[0] || { url: "" };

                      const n = (c.videos || []).length;

                      return (

                        <button key={c.id} type="button" onClick={() => openChannel(i)}

                          style={{ textAlign: "left", padding: 0, borderRadius: 14, overflow: "hidden", border: "1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.4)", background: "#0B1626", cursor: "pointer" }}>

                          <div style={{ position: "relative", height: 104 }}>

                            {thumbBox(first, false)}

                            <span className="font-mono" style={{ position: "absolute", top: 8, right: 8, padding: "3px 8px", borderRadius: 6, fontSize: 9, fontWeight: 800, background: "rgba(3,6,12,0.85)", color: "#E2E8F0" }}>{n} {n === 1 ? "ITEM" : "ITENS"}</span>

                          </div>

                          <div style={{ padding: "10px 10px 12px" }}>

                            {c.badge ? <div className="font-mono" style={{ fontSize: 9, color: "#67E8F9", letterSpacing: "0.08em", marginBottom: 4 }}>{c.badge}</div> : null}

                            <div className="font-hud font-bold" style={{ fontSize: 13, color: "#fff", lineHeight: 1.2 }}>{c.title}</div>

                            {chDesc(c) ? <div style={{ fontSize: 11, lineHeight: 1.35, color: "#CBD5E1", marginTop: 4, ...clamp(3) }}>{chDesc(c)}</div> : null}

                          </div>

                        </button>

                      );

                    })}

                  </div>

                </div>

              ))}

            </div>

          </div>

        );

      }

      // ---------- 2. FEED DO CANAL ----------

      if (view === "feed") {

        const all = items.map((v, i) => ({ ...v, i, kind: itemKind(v.url) }));

        const kinds = [];

        all.forEach((x) => { if (kinds.indexOf(x.kind) < 0) kinds.push(x.kind); });

        const shown = filter === "all" ? all : filter === "ofertas" ? [] : all.filter((x) => x.kind === filter);

        const wide = shown.filter((x) => x.kind === "video");

        const tall = shown.filter((x) => x.kind !== "video" && x.kind !== "site");

        const sq = shown.filter((x) => x.kind === "site");

        // anúncios só entram quando o canal aponta para produtos do catálogo (campo "adIds")

        const adsAll = (ch.adIds || []).map((id) => ads.find((a) => a.id === "AD_" + String(id).replace(/^AD_/, ""))).filter(Boolean);

        const linked = (filter === "all" || filter === "ofertas") ? adsAll.slice() : [];

        const rows = [];

        while (wide.length || tall.length || linked.length || sq.length) {

          if (wide.length) rows.push({ t: "wide", it: wide.shift() });

          if (linked.length) {

            const list = linked.splice(0, 2).map((a) => ({ ad: a }));

            if (list.length < 2 && tall.length) list.push({ it: tall.shift() }); // completa o espaço vazio

            rows.push({ t: "ads", list });

          }

          if (tall.length) rows.push({ t: "tall", list: tall.splice(0, 2).map((it) => ({ it })) });

          if (sq.length) rows.push({ t: "sq", it: sq.shift() });

        }

        const tabBtn = (id, label) => {

          const of = id === "ofertas";

          const on = filter === id;

          return (

            <button key={id} type="button" onClick={() => setFilter(id)} className="font-mono"

              style={{ flex: "0 0 auto", height: 28, padding: "0 13px", borderRadius: 999, fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 800, letterSpacing: "0.06em", cursor: "pointer", border: on ? (of ? "1px solid #FB923C" : "1px solid #22D3EE") : (of ? "1px solid rgba(251,146,60,0.55)" : "1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.35)"), background: on ? (of ? "rgba(251,146,60,0.18)" : "rgba(34,211,238,0.16)") : "#0B1626", color: on ? (of ? "#FED7AA" : "#A5F3FC") : (of ? "#FDBA74" : "#CBD5E1") }}>{label}</button>

          );

        };

        return (

          <div style={{ minHeight: "100vh", paddingBottom: 24 }}>

            {topBar}

            {tabsBar}

            <div style={{ padding: "14px 12px 0" }}>

              <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 12 }}>

                {backBtn(() => up("home"), "cyan")}

                <div style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>

                  <div className="font-hud font-bold" style={{ fontSize: 16, color: "#fff", letterSpacing: "0.04em" }}>{ch.title}</div>

                  <div className="font-mono" style={{ fontSize: 10, color: "#94A3B8" }}>{ch.badge ? ch.badge + " · " : ""}{items.length} ITENS</div>

                </div>

              </div>

              {chDesc(ch) ? <div style={{ fontSize: 12, lineHeight: 1.45, color: "#CBD5E1", marginTop: 12, whiteSpace: "pre-wrap", wordBreak: "break-word" }}>{chDesc(ch)}</div> : null}

              <div className="hud-scroll" style={{ display: "flex", marginTop: 14, overflowX: "auto", paddingBottom: 4 }}>

               <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, margin: "0 auto" }}>

                {tabBtn("all", "TUDO")}

                {kinds.map((k) => tabBtn(k, KIND_TAB[k]))}

                {adsAll.length ? tabBtn("ofertas", "OFERTAS") : null}

               </div>

              </div>

              <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 12, marginTop: 12 }}>

                {rows.map((r, ri) => {

                  if (r.t === "wide") {

                    return (

                      <div key={"w" + ri}>

                      <button type="button" onClick={() => openItem(chIdx, r.it.i)}

                        style={{ position: "relative", width: "100%", aspectRatio: "16 / 9", padding: 0, borderRadius: 14, overflow: "hidden", border: "1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.4)", background: "#0B1626", cursor: "pointer", textAlign: "left" }}>

                        {thumbBox(r.it)}

                        {tag("VÍDEO · 16:9")}

                      </button>

                      {capTitle(r.it.label, "VÍDEO", r.it.desc, () => openItem(chIdx, r.it.i))}

                      </div>

                    );

                  }

                  if (r.t === "ads") {

                    return (

                      <div key={"a" + ri} style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr))", gap: 12 }}>

                        {r.list.map((e) => e.it ? (

                          <div key={"i" + e.it.i}><button type="button" onClick={() => openItem(chIdx, e.it.i)}

                            style={{ position: "relative", aspectRatio: "9 / 16", padding: 0, borderRadius: 14, overflow: "hidden", border: "1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.4)", background: "#0B1626", cursor: "pointer", textAlign: "left" }}>

                            {tag(KIND_LABEL[e.it.kind])}

                            </button>{capTitle(e.it.label, KIND_LABEL[e.it.kind], e.it.desc, () => openItem(chIdx, e.it.i))}</div>

                        ) : ((a) => a.page ? (<div key={a.id} style={{ display: "flex" }}><AdCard a={a} onClick={() => openAd(a.id, "feed")} /></div>) : (

                            style={{ position: "relative", aspectRatio: "9 / 16", padding: 0, borderRadius: 14, overflow: "hidden", border: "1px solid #F97316", background: "#0B1626", cursor: "pointer", textAlign: "left" }}>

                            <AdMedia item={(a.media.find((x) => x.t !== "vid")) || a.media[0]} fallback={a.offer.thumbImg} alt={a.title} />

                            {a.offer.badge ? tag(a.offer.badge, true) : null}

                            <div style={{ position: "absolute", left: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0, padding: "26px 10px 10px", background: "linear-gradient(transparent, rgba(0,0,0,0.9))" }}>

                              <div className="font-hud font-bold" style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "#fff", lineHeight: 1.25, marginBottom: 4 }}>{a.title}</div>

                            </div>

                          </button>

                        ))(e.ad))}

                      </div>

                    );

                  }

                  if (r.t === "sq") {

                    return (

                      <div key={"s" + ri}>

                      <button type="button" onClick={() => openItem(chIdx, r.it.i)}

                        style={{ position: "relative", width: "100%", aspectRatio: "1 / 1", padding: 0, borderRadius: 14, overflow: "hidden", border: "1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.4)", background: "#0B1626", cursor: "pointer", textAlign: "left" }}>

                        {thumbBox(r.it)}

                        {tag("SITE · 1:1")}

                      </button>

                      {capTitle(r.it.label, "SITE", r.it.desc, () => openItem(chIdx, r.it.i))}

                      </div>

                    );

                  }

                  return (

                    <div key={"t" + ri} style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr))", gap: 12 }}>

                      {r.list.map((e) => e.it).map((it) => (

                        <div key={it.i}><button type="button" onClick={() => openItem(chIdx, it.i)}

                          style={{ position: "relative", aspectRatio: "9 / 16", padding: 0, borderRadius: 14, overflow: "hidden", border: "1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.4)", background: "#0B1626", cursor: "pointer", textAlign: "left" }}>

                          {thumbBox(it)}

                          {tag(KIND_LABEL[it.kind])}

                          </button>{capTitle(it.label, KIND_LABEL[it.kind], it.desc, () => openItem(chIdx, it.i))}</div>

                      ))}

                    </div>

                  );

                })}

                {!rows.length && <p className="font-mono" style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "#64748B", textAlign: "center", padding: "30px 0" }}>Nenhum item nesta aba.</p>}

              </div>

            </div>

          </div>

        );

      }

      // ---------- 3. VISUALIZADORES ----------

      if (view === "viewer" && item) {

        const wideView = kind === "video";

        const prevNext = (

          <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 10 }}>

              style={{ flex: 1, height: 48, borderRadius: 12, border: "1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.5)", background: "#0B1626", color: "#67E8F9", fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 12, letterSpacing: "0.08em", cursor: "pointer" }}>◀ ANTERIOR</button>

            <button type="button" onClick={() => { playHoloSound("click"); advance(1); }} className="font-mono"

              style={{ flex: 1, height: 48, borderRadius: 12, border: "1px solid #F97316", background: "rgba(249,115,22,0.14)", color: "#FDBA74", fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 12, letterSpacing: "0.08em", cursor: "pointer" }}>PRÓXIMO ▶</button>

          </div>

        );

        // Lab 21: lista "A SEGUIR NESTE CANAL" para todos os formatos

        const upNext = items.length > 1 ? (

            <div className="font-mono" style={{ fontSize: 10, color: "#94A3B8", letterSpacing: "0.12em", margin: "14px 0 8px" }}>A SEGUIR NESTE CANAL</div>

            <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 10 }}>

              {items.map((v, i) => ({ v, i })).filter((x) => x.i !== itemIdx).map(({ v, i }) => (

                <button key={i} type="button" onClick={() => { setItemIdx(i); setRotated(false); syncItemUrl(chIdx, i, "replace"); toTop(); }}

                  style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 12, padding: 8, borderRadius: 12, border: "1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.3)", background: "#0B1626", textAlign: "left", cursor: "pointer" }}>

                  <div style={{ flex: "0 0 84px", height: 56, borderRadius: 8, overflow: "hidden" }}>{thumbBox(v, false)}</div>

                  <div style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>

                    <div className="font-mono" style={{ fontSize: 10, color: "#94A3B8" }}>{KIND_LABEL[itemKind(v.url)]}</div>

                  </div>

                </button>

              ))}

            </div>

          </div>

        ) : null;

        // 3b. vídeo girado em paisagem (tela cheia)

        if (rotated && wideView) {

          return (

            <div style={{ position: "fixed", top: 0, left: 0, width: "100vh", height: "100vw", transformOrigin: "top left", transform: "translateX(100vw) rotate(90deg)", background: "#000", zIndex: 60 }}>

              <div style={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0 }}>{player(item)}</div>

              <button type="button" aria-label="Sair da paisagem" onClick={() => setRotated(false)}

                style={{ position: "absolute", top: 10, left: 10, width: 44, height: 44, borderRadius: 12, border: "1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.5)", background: "rgba(5,10,20,0.85)", color: "#67E8F9", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", zIndex: 5, cursor: "pointer" }}>

                <Ico><line x1="19" y1="12" x2="5" y2="12"></line><polyline points="12 19 5 12 12 5"></polyline></Ico>

              </button>

              <div style={{ position: "absolute", bottom: 10, right: 10, display: "flex", gap: 8, zIndex: 5 }}>

                <button type="button" aria-label="Anterior" onClick={() => advance(-1)} style={{ width: 44, height: 44, borderRadius: 12, border: "1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.5)", background: "rgba(5,10,20,0.85)", color: "#67E8F9", cursor: "pointer" }}>◀</button>

                <button type="button" aria-label="Próximo" onClick={() => advance(1)} style={{ width: 44, height: 44, borderRadius: 12, border: "1px solid #F97316", background: "rgba(5,10,20,0.85)", color: "#FDBA74", cursor: "pointer" }}>▶</button>

              </div>

            </div>

          );

        }

        const sub = "ITEM " + (itemIdx + 1) + " DE " + items.length;

        if (wideView) {

          return (

            <div style={{ minHeight: "100vh", paddingBottom: 24 }}>

              {subHeader(ch.title, sub, () => up(itemBack), "cyan", autoBtn)}

              <div style={{ position: "relative", width: "100%", aspectRatio: "16 / 9", background: "#000" }}>

                {player(item)}

                <button type="button" aria-label="Girar para paisagem" onClick={() => { setRotated(true); }}

                  style={{ position: "absolute", right: 8, bottom: 8, width: 40, height: 40, borderRadius: 10, border: "1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.5)", background: "rgba(5,10,20,0.8)", color: "#67E8F9", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", cursor: "pointer", zIndex: 5 }}>

                  <Ico><polyline points="23 4 23 10 17 10"></polyline><path d="M20.49 15a9 9 0 1 1-2.12-9.36L23 10"></path></Ico>

                </button>

              </div>

              <div style={{ padding: "14px 12px 0" }}>

                <h2 className="font-hud font-bold" style={{ fontSize: 20, color: "#fff" }}>{item.label}</h2>

                <div className="font-mono" style={{ fontSize: 10, color: "#67E8F9", letterSpacing: "0.08em", margin: "6px 0 14px" }}>{KIND_LABEL[kind]} · {parseOmniLink(item.url).badge} · 16:9</div>

                {item.desc ? <div style={{ fontSize: 13, lineHeight: 1.5, color: "#CBD5E1", margin: "0 0 14px", whiteSpace: "pre-wrap", wordBreak: "break-word" }}>{item.desc}</div> : null}

                {prevNext}

              </div>

              {upNext}

            </div>

          );

        }

        // site e PDF: largura total (nao cabem num palco 9:16)

        if (kind === "site" || kind === "pdf") {

          return (

              {kind === "site" && isBlockedSite(item) ? (

                    <div className="font-mono" style={{ fontSize: 10, color: "#94A3B8", letterSpacing: "0.1em", marginBottom: 12 }}>ESTE SITE NÃO ABRE DENTRO DA TV</div>

                    <a href={item.url} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="font-hud font-bold"

                      style={{ display: "inline-block", padding: "16px 28px", borderRadius: 14, background: "#F97316", color: "#1A0A00", fontSize: 18, letterSpacing: "0.08em", textDecoration: "none", boxShadow: "0 0 24px rgba(249,115,22,0.5)" }}>ABRIR SITE ↗</a>

                  </div>

                </div>

              ) : (

                <div style={{ position: "relative", width: "100%", height: "calc(100dvh - 215px)", minHeight: 360, background: "#000", overflow: "hidden" }}>

                  {player(item)}

                </div>

              )}

              {kind === "site" && !isBlockedSite(item) && (

                <a href={item.url} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="font-mono"

                  style={{ display: "block", padding: "8px 12px", background: "#07101D", color: "#67E8F9", fontSize: 11, letterSpacing: "0.08em", textAlign: "center", textDecoration: "none", borderTop: "1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.2)" }}>NÃO CARREGOU? ABRIR EM NOVA ABA ↗</a>

              )}

              {autoPlay && (

                <button type="button" onClick={() => setSiteHold(!siteHold)} className="font-mono"

                  style={{ display: "block", width: "100%", padding: "10px 12px", background: siteHold ? "rgba(249,115,22,0.16)" : "#07101D", color: siteHold ? "#FDBA74" : "#67E8F9", fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 800, letterSpacing: "0.08em", textAlign: "center", border: 0, borderTop: "1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.2)", cursor: "pointer" }}>

                  {siteHold ? "⏸ AUTOPLAY PAUSADO NESTE SITE · TOQUE PARA SEGUIR" : "🔒 FICAR NESTE SITE (PAUSA O AUTOPLAY)"}

                </button>

              )}

              <div style={{ padding: "10px 12px 0", background: "#050A14" }}>

                <div className="font-hud font-bold" style={{ fontSize: 15, color: "#fff", textTransform: "uppercase" }}>{item.label}</div>

                <div className="font-mono" style={{ fontSize: 10, color: "#94A3B8", letterSpacing: "0.1em", margin: "4px 0 10px" }}>{KIND_LABEL[kind]} · TELA CHEIA</div>

                {item.desc ? <div style={{ fontSize: 13, lineHeight: 1.5, color: "#CBD5E1", margin: "0 0 10px", whiteSpace: "pre-wrap", wordBreak: "break-word" }}>{item.desc}</div> : null}

              </div>

              {upNext}

            <div style={{ position: "sticky", bottom: 0, padding: "8px 12px calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))", background: "#050A14", borderTop: "1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.2)" }}>{prevNext}</div>

            </div>

          );

        }

        // visualizador em pé 9:16 (Short, imagem)

        return (

          <div style={{ minHeight: "100vh", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column" }}>

            {subHeader(ch.title, sub, () => up(itemBack), "cyan", autoBtn)}

            <div style={{ flex: "0 0 auto", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", padding: "8px 0", background: "#000" }}

              onTouchStart={(e) => { touchY.current = e.touches[0].clientY; }}

              onTouchEnd={(e) => {

                if (touchY.current === null) return;

                const dy = touchY.current - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;

                touchY.current = null;

                if (dy > 70) advance(1); else if (dy < -70) advance(-1);

              }}>

              <div style={{ position: "relative", height: "calc(100dvh - 235px)", minHeight: 320, aspectRatio: "9 / 16", maxWidth: "100%", overflow: "hidden", background: "#000" }}>

                {player(item)}

                <span className="font-mono" style={{ position: "absolute", top: 8, left: 8, padding: "3px 8px", borderRadius: 6, fontSize: 9, fontWeight: 800, background: "rgba(3,6,12,0.85)", color: "#67E8F9", border: "1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.35)", zIndex: 5, pointerEvents: "none" }}>{KIND_LABEL[kind]} · 9:16</span>

              </div>

            </div>

              <div className="font-mono" style={{ fontSize: 10, color: "#94A3B8", letterSpacing: "0.1em", margin: "4px 0 10px" }}>▲ DESLIZE NO PLAYER PARA O PRÓXIMO · ROLE PARA VER O CANAL</div>

              {item.desc ? <div style={{ fontSize: 13, lineHeight: 1.5, color: "#CBD5E1", margin: "0 0 10px", whiteSpace: "pre-wrap", wordBreak: "break-word" }}>{item.desc}</div> : null}

            </div>

            {upNext}

            <div style={{ position: "sticky", bottom: 0, padding: "8px 12px calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))", background: "#050A14", borderTop: "1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.2)" }}>{prevNext}</div>

          </div>

        );

      }

      // ---------- 4. ANÚNCIO COMPLETO (em pé) ----------

      // Lab 24: anúncio por link = a própria página do anúncio, em tela cheia, com a faixa de proteção sobre o topo dela

      if (view === "ad" && curAd && curAd.page) {

                style={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, width: "100%", height: "100%", border: 0, background: "#000" }} />

            </div>

          </div>

        );

      }

      if (view === "ad" && curAd) {

        return (

              )}

            </div>

              <a href={o.affiliateLink} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="font-hud font-bold"

                {o.cta || "VER OFERTA"}

      return (
