          <div style={{ padding: "16px 12px 0" }}>

            <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "baseline", justifyContent: "space-between" }}>

              <h2 className="font-hud font-bold" style={{ fontSize: 15, color: "#FB923C", letterSpacing: "0.06em" }}>OFERTAS IMPERDÍVEIS</h2>

              <span className="font-mono" style={{ fontSize: 10, color: "#94A3B8" }}>TOTAL: {ads.length}</span>

            </div>

            {!ads.length && <p className="font-mono" style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "#64748B", textAlign: "center", padding: "40px 0" }}>Nenhuma oferta ainda.</p>}

            <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr))", gap: 12, marginTop: 14 }}>

              {ads.map((a) => a.page ? (<div key={a.id} style={{ display: "flex" }}><AdCard a={a} onClick={() => openAd(a.id, "offers")} /></div>) : (

                <button key={a.id} type="button" onClick={() => openAd(a.id, "offers")}

                  style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", padding: 0, borderRadius: 14, overflow: "hidden", border: "1px solid #F97316", background: "#0B1626", cursor: "pointer", textAlign: "left" }}>

                  <div style={{ position: "relative", width: "100%", aspectRatio: "9 / 14" }}>

                    <AdMedia item={(a.media.find((x) => x.t !== "vid")) || a.media[0]} fallback={a.offer.thumbImg} alt={a.title} />

                    {a.offer.badge ? tag(a.offer.badge, true) : null}

                  </div>

                  <div style={{ padding: "10px 10px 12px" }}>

                    <div className="font-hud font-bold" style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "#fff", lineHeight: 1.25, marginBottom: 6 }}>{a.title}</div>

                    {priceBlock(a.offer, false)}

                    <div className="font-hud font-bold" style={{ marginTop: 10, height: 36, borderRadius: 10, background: "linear-gradient(90deg,#F97316,#EF4444)", color: "#1A0A00", fontSize: 11, letterSpacing: "0.08em", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center" }}>COMPRAR</div>

                  </div>

                </button>

              ))}

            </div>

            <p className="font-mono" style={{ fontSize: 10, color: "#64748B", marginTop: 14 }}>Os produtos vêm do catálogo. Cada card abre o anúncio completo em pé.</p>

          </div>

        </div>

      );

    }

    function AppInner({ initCh, adsPub, adsLoading, chatTxt }) {

      const [channels, setChannels] = useState(initCh);

      const initDeep = useRef(readItemParamsFromUrl(initCh)).current;

      const [currentIndex, setCurrentIndex] = useState(initDeep ? initDeep.ci : 0);

      const [selectedVideoIdx, setSelectedVideoIdx] = useState(initDeep ? initDeep.ii : 0);

      const [selectedOfferIdx, setSelectedOfferIdx] = useState(0);

      const [isPipVisible, setIsPipVisible] = useState(true);

      const [isPipExpanded, setIsPipExpanded] = useState(false);

      const [isSwapped, setIsSwapped] = useState(false);

      const [isMainHovered, setIsMainHovered] = useState(false);

      const [isMuted, setIsMuted] = useState(false);

      // som: se o navegador bloqueou o som automático, o primeiro clique/toque/tecla do visitante liga o som (30%)

      const autoMutedRef = useRef(false);

      const reportBlocked = () => { autoMutedRef.current = true; setIsMuted(true); };

      useEffect(() => {

        const onGesture = (e) => {

          if (!autoMutedRef.current) return;

          const t = e && e.target;

          const btn = t && t.closest ? t.closest("button") : null;

          // se a pessoa mexeu no próprio botão de som, a escolha dela vale

          if (btn && /som (ligado|desligado)/i.test((btn.getAttribute("aria-label") || "") + " " + (btn.textContent || ""))) { autoMutedRef.current = false; return; }

          autoMutedRef.current = false;

          setIsMuted(false);

        };

        const evs = ["pointerup", "keydown", "touchend"];

        evs.forEach((n) => window.addEventListener(n, onGesture, true));

        return () => evs.forEach((n) => window.removeEventListener(n, onGesture, true));

      }, []);

      const [autoPlayNext, setAutoPlayNext] = useState(true);

      const [playNonce, setPlayNonce] = useState(0);

      const [holdSec, setHoldSec] = useState(() => {

        try { return Math.max(5, +localStorage.getItem("BRUTE_HOLD_SEC") || 60); } catch (e) { return 60; }

      });

      const advanceRef = useRef(null);

      const failTimer = useRef(null);

      const [isSidebarOpen, setIsSidebarOpen] = useState(() => {

        try { return localStorage.getItem("BRUTE_SIDEBAR_OPEN") !== "0"; } catch (e) { return true; }

      });

      // ADMIN & DRAGÃO

      const [isFlagOpen, setIsFlagOpen] = useState(false);

      // v4: no celular (tela estreita) entra o layout novo; no PC nada muda

      const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = useState(() => {

        try { return window.matchMedia("(max-width: 820px)").matches; } catch (e) { return false; }

      });

      useEffect(() => {

        let mq;

        try { mq = window.matchMedia("(max-width: 820px)"); } catch (e) { return; }

        const on = () => setIsMobile(mq.matches);

        if (mq.addEventListener) mq.addEventListener("change", on); else mq.addListener(on);

        return () => { if (mq.removeEventListener) mq.removeEventListener("change", on); else mq.removeListener(on); };

      }, []);

      const mSvg = (size, children) => (

        <svg width={size} height={size} viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.75" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">{children}</svg>

      );

      const mBarBtn = (label, pressed, tone, onClick, icon) => {

        const tones = {

          on: { border: "1px solid #F97316", background: "rgba(249,115,22,0.16)", color: "#FDBA74" },

          cyan: { border: "1px solid #22D3EE", background: "rgba(34,211,238,0.14)", color: "#A5F3FC" },

          off: { border: "1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.45)", background: "#0B1626", color: "#CBD5E1" },

          neutral: { border: "1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.35)", background: "#0B1626", color: "#67E8F9" }

        };

        return (

          <button type="button" aria-label={label} title={label} aria-pressed={pressed} onClick={onClick}

            style={{ flex: 1, height: 44, padding: 0, borderRadius: 12, display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", cursor: "pointer", ...tones[tone] }}>

            {icon}

          </button>

        );

      };

     

      // ESTÚDIO MULTI-PÁGINA: Canal em edição aprofundada!

      // ANÚNCIOS DO MONITOR MENOR (vindos do catálogo v4), independentes do telão

      const [ads, setAds] = useState([]);

      const [adIdx, setAdIdx] = useState(0);

      const [adMediaIdx, setAdMediaIdx] = useState(0);

      const [adSec, setAdSec] = useState(() => {

        try { return +localStorage.getItem("BRUTE_AD_SEC") || 10; } catch (e) { return 10; }

      });

      const [adminTab, setAdminTab] = useState("conteudo");

      const [catUrl, setCatUrl] = useState(() => {

        try { return localStorage.getItem("BRUTE_CAT_URL") || "https://brute-man-produtos.netlify.app/"; } catch (e) { return "https://brute-man-produtos.netlify.app/"; }

      });

      useEffect(() => {

        try { localStorage.setItem("BRUTE_HOLD_SEC", String(holdSec)); } catch (e) {}

      }, [holdSec]);

      useEffect(() => {

        try { localStorage.setItem("BRUTE_AD_SEC", String(adSec)); } catch (e) {}

      }, [adSec]);

      useEffect(() => {

        try { localStorage.setItem("BRUTE_CAT_URL", catUrl); } catch (e) {}

      }, [catUrl]);

      // anúncios do catálogo entram quando o catalogo.json chega (os canais já vieram antes)

      useEffect(() => {

        if (adsPub && adsPub.length) { setAds(adsPub); setAdIdx(0); setAdMediaIdx(0); }

      }, [adsPub]);

      // Lab 23b: vínculo anúncio-canal no PC (igual ao celular): se o canal tem "adIds", o monitor mostra só esses

      const pcCh = channels[currentIndex] || channels[0];

      const pcAds = (() => {

        const ids = (pcCh && pcCh.adIds) || [];

        const l = ids.map((id) => ads.find((a) => a.id === "AD_" + String(id).replace(/^AD_/, ""))).filter(Boolean);

        return l.length ? l : ads;

      })();

      useEffect(() => { setAdIdx(0); setAdMediaIdx(0); }, [currentIndex]);

      // Lab 23: o anúncio abre como página no monitor menor; ao mexer nele (ou travar no botão), o giro para

      const [adHold, setAdHold] = useState(false);

      useEffect(() => { setAdHold(false); }, [adIdx]);

      useEffect(() => {

        if (!isPipVisible || isSwapped) return;

        const onBlur = () => setTimeout(() => { const a = document.activeElement; if (a && a.tagName === "IFRAME" && a.getAttribute("data-adpage")) setAdHold(true); }, 0);

        window.addEventListener("blur", onBlur);

        return () => window.removeEventListener("blur", onBlur);

      }, [isPipVisible, isSwapped, adIdx]);

      // gira os anúncios sozinho, solto do que passa no telão

      useEffect(() => {

        if (pcAds.length < 2 || adHold) return;

        const t = setInterval(() => { setAdIdx((i) => (i + 1) % pcAds.length); setAdMediaIdx(0); }, Math.max(3, adSec) * 1000);

        return () => clearInterval(t);

      }, [pcAds.length, adSec, adHold]);

      // dentro de cada anúncio, troca foto/vídeo/GIF

      useEffect(() => {

        const cur = pcAds.length ? pcAds[adIdx % pcAds.length] : null;

        if (!cur || !cur.media || cur.media.length < 2) return;

        const t = setInterval(() => setAdMediaIdx((m) => m + 1), 3500);

        return () => clearInterval(t);

      }, [ads, adIdx, pcAds.length]);

      useEffect(() => {

        try { localStorage.setItem("BRUTE_SIDEBAR_OPEN", isSidebarOpen ? "1" : "0"); } catch (e) {}

      }, [isSidebarOpen]);

      useEffect(() => {

        const handleKeyDown = (e) => {

          const tag = (e.target && e.target.tagName) || "";

          if ((e.key === "c" || e.key === "C") && !e.ctrlKey && !e.metaKey && !e.altKey && !/INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT/.test(tag)) {

            setIsSidebarOpen((v) => !v);

          }

          if (e.key === "Escape") {

          }

        };

        window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);

        return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);

      }, []);

      // Sincroniza URL (?canal=X&item=Y) no desktop

      const isFirstDesktopSync = useRef(true);

      const isPopDesktopRef = useRef(false);

      useEffect(() => {

        if (isMobile) return;

        if (isFirstDesktopSync.current) {

          isFirstDesktopSync.current = false;

          if (initDeep) syncItemUrl(currentIndex, selectedVideoIdx, "replace");

          return;

        }

        if (isPopDesktopRef.current) {

          isPopDesktopRef.current = false;

          return;

        }

        syncItemUrl(currentIndex, selectedVideoIdx, "push");

      }, [currentIndex, selectedVideoIdx, isMobile]);

      useEffect(() => {

        if (isMobile) return;

        const onPopDesktop = () => {

          const p = readItemParamsFromUrl(channels);

          isPopDesktopRef.current = true;

          if (p) {

            setCurrentIndex(p.ci);

            setSelectedVideoIdx(p.ii);

          } else {

            setCurrentIndex(0);

            setSelectedVideoIdx(0);

          }

        };

        window.addEventListener("popstate", onPopDesktop);

        return () => window.removeEventListener("popstate", onPopDesktop);

      }, [isMobile, channels]);

      const selectChannel = (idx) => {

        playHoloSound('swap');

        setCurrentIndex(idx);

        setSelectedVideoIdx(0);

        setSelectedOfferIdx(0);

        if (channels[idx]) {

          window.location.hash = channels[idx].slug || channels[idx].id;

        }

      };

      const handleProximoCanal = () => {

        playHoloSound('swap');

        const next = (currentIndex + 1) % channels.length;

        selectChannel(next);

      };

      const handleCanalAnterior = () => {

        playHoloSound('swap');

        const prev = (currentIndex - 1 + channels.length) % channels.length;

        selectChannel(prev);

      };

      const currentChannel = channels[currentIndex] || channels[0];

      const activeVideo = currentChannel.videos[selectedVideoIdx] || currentChannel.videos[0];

      // ===== LOOP DOS CONTEÚDOS =====

      // próximo vídeo do canal; acabou o canal, vai para o próximo canal; acabou tudo, volta ao começo.

      const advanceContent = () => {

        if (selectedVideoIdx + 1 < currentChannel.videos.length) {

          setSelectedVideoIdx(selectedVideoIdx + 1);

        } else if (channels.length > 1) {

          handleProximoCanal();

        } else {

          setSelectedVideoIdx(0);

          setPlayNonce((n) => n + 1);

        }

      };

      advanceRef.current = advanceContent;

      const totalContents = channels.reduce((sum, c) => sum + (c.videos || []).length, 0);

      // Lab 21c: ao mexer dentro do site (ou travar no botao), o relogio do autoplay para

      const [pcSiteHold, setPcSiteHold] = useState(false);

      const pcIsSiteLike = ["WEBSITE", "PDF", "GOOGLE_DRIVE"].indexOf(parseOmniLink(activeVideo.url).type) >= 0;

      useEffect(() => { setPcSiteHold(false); }, [currentIndex, selectedVideoIdx, activeVideo.url, playNonce]);

      useEffect(() => {

        if (!pcIsSiteLike) return;

        const onBlur = () => setTimeout(() => { const a = document.activeElement; if (a && a.tagName === "IFRAME") setPcSiteHold(true); }, 0);

        window.addEventListener("blur", onBlur);

        return () => window.removeEventListener("blur", onBlur);

      }, [pcIsSiteLike, currentIndex, selectedVideoIdx, activeVideo.url]);

      // sites, notícias, PDF, Drive e imagens não "terminam": ficam um tempo na tela e passam

      useEffect(() => {

        if (!autoPlayNext || pcSiteHold) return;

        const t = parseOmniLink(activeVideo.url).type;

        if (["WEBSITE", "PDF", "GOOGLE_DRIVE", "IMAGE"].indexOf(t) < 0) return;

        const id = setTimeout(() => { if (advanceRef.current) advanceRef.current(); }, Math.max(5, holdSec) * 1000);

        return () => clearTimeout(id);

      }, [autoPlayNext, currentIndex, selectedVideoIdx, activeVideo.url, holdSec, playNonce, pcSiteHold]);

      // se um vídeo do YouTube der erro, não trava: pula depois de 5 s (só se houver outro conteúdo)

      useEffect(() => () => clearTimeout(failTimer.current), [currentIndex, selectedVideoIdx, playNonce]);

      const handleContentFail = () => {

        if (!autoPlayNext || totalContents < 2) return;

        clearTimeout(failTimer.current);

        failTimer.current = setTimeout(() => { if (advanceRef.current) advanceRef.current(); }, 5000);

      };

      const curAd = pcAds.length ? pcAds[adIdx % pcAds.length] : null;

      const adPageUrl = curAd

        ? (curAd.page || (catUrl.trim().replace(/#.*$/, "").replace(/\/?$/, "/") + "#/p/" + String(curAd.id).replace(/^AD_/, "")))

        : "";

      const chOffers = currentChannel.offers || [];

      const activeOffer = curAd ? curAd.offer : (chOffers[selectedOfferIdx] || chOffers[0] || null);

      // Telão: quanto mais espaço livre (monitor menor e/ou barra fechados), maior e mais reto.

      const isExpanded = !isPipVisible && !isSidebarOpen;

      const shouldApplyFocusFront = !isPipVisible && isMainHovered;

      const tvRotY = isPipVisible ? 14 : (isSidebarOpen ? 5 : 1.2);

      const tvRotX = isPipVisible ? 3 : (isSidebarOpen ? 1.2 : 0.4);

      const tvWidth = isPipVisible ? "min(90cqw, 158cqh)" : "min(97cqw, 172cqh)";

      // fechar o monitor menor: se o conteúdo do telão estava nele, volta antes para o telão

      const closePip = () => { if (isSwapped) setIsSwapped(false); setIsPipVisible(false); };

      const renderMainContent = () => (

        <OmniScreenRenderer

          key={playNonce + "-" + currentIndex + "-" + selectedVideoIdx}

          videoUrl={activeVideo.url}

          title={activeVideo.label || currentChannel.title}

          isMuted={isMuted} onBlocked={reportBlocked}

          autoAdvance={autoPlayNext}

          onVideoEnded={() => { if (advanceRef.current) advanceRef.current(); }}

          onFail={handleContentFail}

        />

      );

      const renderProductCardContent = () => !activeOffer ? (

        <div className="flex flex-col h-full items-center justify-center text-center gap-2 p-4">

          <div className="text-3xl">🛒</div>

          <div className="font-hud font-bold text-[11px] text-orange-300">{adsLoading ? "CARREGANDO OFERTAS..." : "SEM OFERTAS NO MOMENTO"}</div>

          {adsLoading ? <div className="text-[9px] font-mono text-gray-400">Só mais um instante.</div> : null}

        </div>

      ) : (

        <div className="flex flex-col h-full justify-between">

          <div>

            {!curAd && chOffers.length > 1 && (

              <div className="flex gap-1 mb-2 overflow-x-auto hud-scroll pb-1">

                {chOffers.map((off, oIdx) => (

                  <button

                    key={oIdx}

                    onClick={() => { playHoloSound('click'); setSelectedOfferIdx(oIdx); }}

                    className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[8px] font-mono font-bold whitespace-nowrap transition ${

                      selectedOfferIdx === oIdx ? 'bg-orange-600 text-white shadow' : 'bg-slate-900 text-gray-400 hover:text-white'

                    }`}

                  >

                    OFERTA {oIdx + 1}: {off.badge}

                  </button>

                ))}

              </div>

            )}

            <div className="flex gap-3 items-center">

              <div className={`${curAd ? "w-28 h-40" : "w-24 h-24"} rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-orange-500/40 bg-black/80 flex-shrink-0 relative`}>

                {curAd

                  ? <AdMedia item={curAd.media[adMediaIdx % (curAd.media.length || 1)]} fallback={activeOffer.thumbImg} alt={activeOffer.title} />

                  : <SafeImage src={activeOffer.thumbImg} alt={activeOffer.title} className="w-full h-full object-cover" />}

                <span className="absolute top-1 left-1 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-orange-600 text-white font-bold text-[7px] font-mono">

                  {activeOffer.badge}

                </span>

                {curAd && curAd.media.length > 1 && (

                  <div className="absolute bottom-1 left-0 right-0 flex justify-center gap-1">

                    {curAd.media.map((_, i) => (

                      <span key={i} className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${i === adMediaIdx % curAd.media.length ? "bg-orange-400" : "bg-white/40"}`}></span>

                    ))}

                  </div>

                )}

              </div>

              <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">

                <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[8px] font-mono text-yellow-400 mb-0.5">

                  {activeOffer.rating && <span>{activeOffer.rating}</span>}

                  <span className="text-gray-400">{activeOffer.rating ? "• " : ""}{activeOffer.sold}</span>

                </div>

                <h4 className="font-hud font-bold text-xs text-white leading-tight truncate mb-1">

                  {activeOffer.title}

                </h4>

                <div className="space-y-0.5 text-[8px] font-mono text-gray-300">

                  {activeOffer.features.slice(0, isPipExpanded ? 4 : 2).map((feat, i) => (

                    <p key={i} className="truncate text-gray-400">• {feat}</p>

                  ))}

                </div>

              </div>

            </div>

          </div>

          {isPipExpanded && (

            <div className="my-2 p-2 rounded-lg bg-orange-950/40 border border-orange-500/30 text-[9px] font-mono text-orange-200 leading-relaxed">

              <span className="font-bold text-orange-400">ESTUDO DE CASO: </span>

              {currentChannel.caseStudy}

            </div>

          )}

          <div className="hb-pricerow flex items-center justify-between pt-1 border-t border-orange-500/30">

            <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2">

              {activeOffer.priceOld && <span className="text-[10px] font-mono line-through text-gray-500">{activeOffer.priceOld}</span>}

              <span className="font-hud font-extrabold text-base text-orange-400">{activeOffer.priceCurrent}</span>

              {activeOffer.discount && <span className="px-1 py-0.2 rounded bg-red-950 text-red-400 font-bold text-[8px] font-mono">{activeOffer.discount}</span>}

            </div>

            <a

              href={activeOffer.affiliateLink}

              target="_blank"

              rel="noopener noreferrer"

              className="py-1.5 px-3 rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-r from-orange-500 to-red-500 hover:from-orange-400 hover:to-red-400 text-white font-hud font-bold text-[10px] shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(249,115,22,0.6)] active:scale-95 transition"

            >

              {activeOffer.cta || "VER OFERTA"} ➔

            </a>

          </div>

        </div>

      );

      return (

              />

          {/* HEADER PÚBLICO */}

          <header className="hb-header flex items-center justify-between border-b border-cyan-500/20 pb-2 text-xs">

              <div

                className="hb-logo w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-orange-600/30 border border-orange-500 flex items-center justify-center font-hud font-bold text-orange-400 text-xs shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(249,115,22,0.4)] cursor-pointer select-none hover:scale-105 transition"

              <div>

                  TRANSMISSÃO 24/7 • PRODUTOS RECOMENDADOS & ESTUDOS DE CASO

              </div>

            </div>

                  }`}

              )}

              <button

                }`}

          </header>

              <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 10, height: 44 }}>

                <div className="font-hud font-bold" style={{ flex: "0 0 44px", width: 44, height: 44, padding: 0, borderRadius: 12, border: "2px solid #F97316", background: "rgba(249,115,22,0.14)", color: "#FB923C", fontSize: 15, display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center" }}>HB</div>

                  <div className="font-mono" style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 6, fontSize: 10, color: "#67E8F9", letterSpacing: "0.06em", whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}>

                    <span style={{ width: 6, height: 6, borderRadius: "50%", background: "#22D3EE", display: "inline-block" }}></span>

                  {mSvg(22, <><path d="M12 3l1.9 5.1L19 10l-5.1 1.9L12 17l-1.9-5.1L5 10l5.1-1.9z"></path><path d="M19 15l.7 1.8L21.5 17.5l-1.8.7L19 20l-.7-1.8-1.8-.7 1.8-.7z"></path></>)}

                </button>

              </div>

              <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8 }}>

                  mSvg(20, <><path d="M17 2l4 4-4 4"></path><path d="M3 11V9a4 4 0 0 1 4-4h14"></path><path d="M7 22l-4-4 4-4"></path><path d="M21 13v2a4 4 0 0 1-4 4H3"></path></>))}

                {mBarBtn(isMuted ? "Som desligado (tocar para ligar)" : "Som ligado (tocar para desligar)", !isMuted, isMuted ? "off" : "on", () => { playHoloSound('click'); setIsMuted(!isMuted); },

                  isMuted

                    ? mSvg(20, <><polygon points="11 5 6 9 2 9 2 15 6 15 11 19 11 5"></polygon><line x1="23" y1="9" x2="17" y2="15"></line><line x1="17" y1="9" x2="23" y2="15"></line></>)

                    : mSvg(20, <><polygon points="11 5 6 9 2 9 2 15 6 15 11 19 11 5"></polygon><path d="M15.54 8.46a5 5 0 0 1 0 7.07"></path><path d="M19.07 4.93a10 10 0 0 1 0 14.14"></path></>))}

                {mBarBtn("Inverter telas", false, "neutral", () => { playHoloSound('swap'); setIsSwapped(!isSwapped); },

                  mSvg(20, <><path d="M8 3 4 7l4 4"></path><path d="M4 7h16"></path><path d="m16 21 4-4-4-4"></path><path d="M20 17H4"></path></>))}

                {mBarBtn(isPipVisible ? "Esconder monitor da loja" : "Mostrar monitor da loja", isPipVisible, isPipVisible ? "cyan" : "off", () => { playHoloSound('click'); if (isPipVisible) closePip(); else setIsPipVisible(true); },

                  mSvg(20, <><path d="M6 2 3 6v14a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h14a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V6l-3-4z"></path><path d="M3 6h18"></path><path d="M16 10a4 4 0 0 1-8 0"></path></>))}

                {mBarBtn(isSidebarOpen ? "Esconder canais" : "Mostrar canais", isSidebarOpen, isSidebarOpen ? "on" : "off", () => { playHoloSound('click'); setIsSidebarOpen(!isSidebarOpen); },

                  mSvg(20, <><rect x="2" y="7" width="20" height="15" rx="2"></rect><polyline points="17 2 12 7 7 2"></polyline></>))}

              </div>

                <div role="menu" style={{ position: "absolute", top: 66, right: 12, width: 284, maxWidth: "calc(100% - 24px)", padding: 10, borderRadius: 16, border: "1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.5)", background: "#0B1626", boxShadow: "0 14px 34px rgba(0,0,0,0.55)", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 4, zIndex: 50 }}>

                  <div className="font-mono" style={{ padding: "4px 6px 8px", fontSize: 10, letterSpacing: "0.12em", color: "#A78BFA" }}>CLAUDINHA · EM CONSTRUÇÃO</div>

                  {[

                    { label: "Pauta do dia", icon: <><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"></circle><line x1="21" y1="21" x2="16.65" y2="16.65"></line></> },

                    { label: "Radar de tendências", icon: <><polyline points="22 7 13.5 15.5 8.5 10.5 2 17"></polyline><polyline points="16 7 22 7 22 13"></polyline></> },

                    { label: "Diário", icon: <><path d="M2 3h6a4 4 0 0 1 4 4v14a3 3 0 0 0-3-3H2z"></path><path d="M22 3h-6a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v14a3 3 0 0 1 3-3h7z"></path></> },

                    { label: "Fechar o dia", icon: <path d="M21 12.79A9 9 0 1 1 11.21 3 7 7 0 0 0 21 12.79z"></path> }

                  ].map((it) => (

                    <button key={it.label} type="button" role="menuitem" disabled

                      <span style={{ color: "#A78BFA", display: "flex" }}>{mSvg(20, it.icon)}</span>

                      <span style={{ flex: 1 }}>{it.label}</span>

                      <span className="font-mono" style={{ fontSize: 9, letterSpacing: "0.08em", color: "#C4B5FD", border: "1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.45)", borderRadius: 6, padding: "2px 6px" }}>EM BREVE</span>

                    </button>

                  ))}

                </div>

              </>

            )}

          <main className="hb-main flex-1 flex items-stretch my-2 overflow-hidden relative">

            <div className="hb-stage flex-1 min-w-0 perspective-stage relative flex items-center justify-center p-2 pl-8 pr-2" style={{ containerType: "size" }} onMouseEnter={() => setIsMainHovered(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setIsMainHovered(false)}>

              <div

                style={{

                  width: tvWidth,

                  aspectRatio: "16 / 9",

                  ...(shouldApplyFocusFront ? {} : {

                  })

                className={`hb-screen rounded-2xl bg-black/85 border border-cyan-400/50 relative overflow-hidden flex flex-col shrink-0 ${

                }`}

              >

                <svg className="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full pointer-events-none z-30">

                  <defs>

                    <linearGradient id="neonElectricGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">

                      <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#00f2fe" />

                      <stop offset="50%" stopColor="#ec4899" />

                      <stop offset="100%" stopColor="#10b981" />

                    </linearGradient>

                    <filter id="neonGlow">

                      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="3" result="blur" />

                      <feMerge><feMergeNode in="blur" /><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic" /></feMerge>

                    </filter>

                  </defs>

                  <rect

                    x="2" y="2" width="calc(100% - 4px)" height="calc(100% - 4px)" rx="16"

                    fill="none" stroke="url(#neonElectricGrad)" strokeWidth="3" filter="url(#neonGlow)"

                    className="electric-circuit-surge"

                  />

                </svg>

                {/* Topbar com Abas de Vídeos */}

                <div className="hb-topbar h-7 px-3 bg-black/60 border-b border-cyan-400/30 flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] font-mono text-cyan-300 relative z-10">

                    {currentChannel.videos.map((vid, vIdx) => (

                      <button

                        onClick={() => { playHoloSound('click'); setSelectedVideoIdx(vIdx); }}

                          selectedVideoIdx === vIdx ? 'bg-cyan-500/30 text-cyan-200 border border-cyan-400' : 'bg-black/60 text-gray-400'

                        }`}

                      >

                        {vid.label || `VÍDEO ${vIdx + 1}`}

                      </button>

                    ))}

                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">

                    <button onClick={handleCanalAnterior} className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 hover:border-cyan-400 text-cyan-300 text-[9px]">◀</button>

                    <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-400 font-mono">{currentIndex + 1}/{channels.length}</span>

                    <button onClick={handleProximoCanal} className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 hover:border-cyan-400 text-cyan-300 text-[9px]">▶</button>

                  </div>

                </div>

                <div className="flex-1 relative overflow-hidden bg-black/50 flex items-center justify-center p-2">

                  {!isSwapped ? renderMainContent() : (

                      {renderProductCardContent()}

                    </div>

                  )}

                  <div className="absolute top-2 left-2 w-4 h-4 border-t-2 border-l-2 border-cyan-400 pointer-events-none"></div>

                  <div className="absolute top-2 right-2 w-4 h-4 border-t-2 border-r-2 border-cyan-400 pointer-events-none"></div>

                  <div className="absolute bottom-2 right-2 w-4 h-4 border-b-2 border-r-2 border-cyan-400 pointer-events-none"></div>

                </div>

                <div className="h-6 px-4 bg-black/85 border-t border-cyan-400/25 flex items-center justify-between text-[9px] font-mono text-cyan-400/80">

                  <span className="text-orange-400 font-hud font-bold">{currentChannel.auraScore}</span>

              {/* MONITOR COMERCIAL COM MULTI-OFERTAS */}

              {isPipVisible ? (

                <div

                  className={`hb-pip absolute bottom-3 right-3 rounded-2xl bg-black/95 border-2 border-orange-500 shadow-[0_0_35px_rgba(249,115,22,0.45)] overflow-hidden flex flex-col z-30 transition-all duration-300 ${

                    isPipExpanded ? 'w-[520px] h-[350px]' : 'w-[420px] h-[270px]'

                  }`}

                >

                  <div className="holo-scanline"></div>

                  <div className="h-7 px-3 bg-gradient-to-r from-orange-950 to-black border-b border-orange-500/40 flex items-center justify-between text-[9px] font-mono text-orange-300">

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 truncate">

                      <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-orange-500 animate-pulse"></span>

                      <span className="font-bold font-hud tracking-wider">

                        {isSwapped ? "TRANSMISSÃO NO MONITOR MENOR" : curAd ? "ANÚNCIOS (" + ((adIdx % pcAds.length) + 1) + "/" + pcAds.length + ")" : "OFERTAS DO CANAL (" + chOffers.length + ")"}

                      </span>

                    </div>

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1">

                      {curAd && !isSwapped && (

                        <a

                          href={adPageUrl}

                          target="_blank"

                          rel="noopener noreferrer"

                          className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-black/80 hover:bg-orange-500 hover:text-black border border-orange-500/50 text-[8px] font-bold text-orange-200"

                          📄 ANÚNCIO COMPLETO

                        </a>

                      )}

                      {curAd && !isSwapped && pcAds.length > 1 && (

                        <button

                          className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border text-[8px] font-bold ${adHold ? 'bg-orange-500/30 border-orange-400 text-orange-200' : 'bg-black/80 border-cyan-500/60 text-cyan-200'}`}

                        >

                          {adHold ? '⏸ PAUSADO · SEGUIR' : '🔒 FICAR'}

                        </button>

                      )}

                      <button

                        onClick={() => { playHoloSound('swap'); setIsSwapped(!isSwapped); }}

                        title="Troca o conteúdo do telão com o do monitor menor"

                        className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-black/80 hover:bg-cyan-500 hover:text-black border border-cyan-500/60 text-[8px] font-bold text-cyan-200"

                      >

                        ⇄ ALTERNAR

                      </button>

                      <button

                        onClick={() => setIsPipExpanded(!isPipExpanded)}

                        className="hb-expand px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-black/80 hover:bg-orange-500 hover:text-black border border-orange-500/50 text-[8px] font-bold text-orange-200"

                      >

                        {isPipExpanded ? "⤡ REDUZIR" : "⤢ EXPANDIR"}

                      </button>

                      <button

                        onClick={closePip}

                        className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-black/80 hover:bg-red-500 hover:text-white border border-red-500/50 text-[8px] font-bold text-red-300"

                      >

                        ✕

                      </button>

                    </div>

                  </div>

                  <div className="flex-1 p-3 bg-black/60 relative overflow-hidden flex flex-col justify-between">

                    {isSwapped ? renderMainContent() : curAd ? (

                      <iframe key={curAd.id} data-adpage="1" src={adPageUrl} title={"Anúncio " + curAd.id}

                        className="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full border-0 bg-black"

                        sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-popups allow-forms allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox" />

                    ) : renderProductCardContent()}

                    {!isSwapped && curAd && (

                      <div aria-hidden="true" title="Navegação travada neste anúncio"

                        style={{ position: "absolute", top: 0, left: 0, right: 18, height: 64, zIndex: 5, background: "transparent", cursor: "default" }} />

                    )}

                  </div>

                </div>

              ) : (

                <button

                  onClick={() => setIsPipVisible(true)}

                  className="hb-pipbtn absolute bottom-3 right-3 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-orange-950/90 hover:bg-orange-900 border-2 border-orange-500 text-orange-300 font-mono text-[10px] font-bold shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(249,115,22,0.5)] flex items-center gap-2 z-30 transition-all active:scale-95 animate-pulse"

                >

                  <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-orange-400"></span>

                  <span>✦ ABRIR OFERTAS{activeOffer ? " // " + activeOffer.priceCurrent : ""}</span>

                </button>

              )}

            </div>

            {/* COLUNA DIREITA */}

            <div

              className={`hb-side shrink-0 flex flex-col justify-between gap-2 overflow-hidden transition-all duration-500 ease-out ${

                isSidebarOpen ? 'w-80 md:w-[410px] ml-4 opacity-100' : 'w-0 ml-0 opacity-0 pointer-events-none'

              }`}

              aria-hidden={!isSidebarOpen}

            >

              <div className="bg-black/60 border border-orange-500/30 rounded-xl p-2.5 flex-1 flex flex-col justify-between overflow-hidden min-w-[320px] md:min-w-[410px]">

                <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col overflow-hidden">

                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-orange-500/20 pb-1 mb-2">

                    <h3 className="font-hud font-bold text-xs tracking-wider text-orange-400">

                      CANAIS DA SMARTBOX

                    </h3>

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">

                      <span className="text-[9px] font-mono text-gray-400">TOTAL: {channels.length}</span>

                      <button

                        onClick={() => { playHoloSound('click'); setIsSidebarOpen(false); }}

                        title="Esconder canais (C)"

                        className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-900 border border-orange-500/50 hover:border-orange-400 text-orange-300 text-[10px] font-bold"

                      >

                        ⟩

                      </button>

                    </div>

                  </div>

                  <div className="hb-chgrid grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 content-start flex-1 overflow-y-auto hud-scroll pr-1">

                    {channels.map((item, idx) => {

                      const isActive = currentIndex === idx;

                      const thumb = channelThumb(item);

                      const nVid = (item.videos || []).length;

                      const vType = parseOmniLink((item.videos && item.videos[0] && item.videos[0].url) || "").type;

                      return (

                        <div

                          key={item.id}

                          onClick={() => selectChannel(idx)}

                          className={`holo-glass-card rounded-xl p-2 flex flex-col justify-between cursor-pointer ${

                            isActive ? 'active-hud' : ''

                          }`}

                        >

                          <div>

                            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[8px] font-mono mb-1">

                              <span className="text-orange-400 font-bold truncate">{item.badge}</span>

                              <span className="text-yellow-400 font-bold">{nVid} {nVid === 1 ? "item" : "itens"}</span>

                            </div>

                            <h4 className="font-hud font-bold text-[9px] text-white leading-tight mb-1 truncate">

                              {item.title}

                            </h4>

                          </div>

                          <div className="w-full h-16 rounded-lg overflow-hidden bg-black/60 border border-orange-500/30 my-1 relative">

                            {thumb

                              ? <SafeImage src={thumb} alt={item.title} className="w-full h-full object-cover" />

                              : <div className="w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center text-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-900 to-black">{typeIcon(vType)}</div>}

                          </div>

                          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[8px] font-mono text-gray-300 pt-1 border-t border-orange-500/20">

                            <span className="font-bold text-orange-400">{typeIcon(vType)} {item.badge}</span>

                            <span className="text-teal-300 font-bold">VER ⚡</span>

                          </div>

                        </div>

                      );

                    })}

                  </div>

                </div>

                <ChatBox txt={chatTxt} />

              </div>

            </div>

            {!isSidebarOpen && (

              <button

                onClick={() => { playHoloSound('click'); setIsSidebarOpen(true); }}

                title="Mostrar canais (C)"

                className="absolute right-0 top-3 z-40 px-1.5 py-3 rounded-l-xl bg-orange-950/90 hover:bg-orange-900 border border-r-0 border-orange-500 text-orange-300 font-hud font-bold text-[10px] shadow-[0_0_18px_rgba(249,115,22,0.45)] transition active:scale-95"

                style={{ writingMode: 'vertical-rl' }}

              >

                ⟨ CANAIS ({channels.length})

              </button>

            )}

          </main>

          </>)}

          {/* ========================================================

              MODAL DRAGÃO ADMIN MASTER & ESTÚDIO MULTI-PÁGINA

             ======================================================== */}

        </div>

      );

    }

    function IntroScreen({ on, status, onRetry }) {

      const [gone, setGone] = useState(false);

      useEffect(() => {

        if (on) { setGone(false); return; }

        const t = setTimeout(() => setGone(true), 700);

        return () => clearTimeout(t);

      }, [on]);

      if (gone && !on) return null;

      return (

            <div className="hb-intro" style={{ position: "fixed", inset: 0, zIndex: 9999, display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", flexDirection: "column", gap: 26, overflow: "hidden", opacity: on ? 1 : 0, transition: "opacity 0.6s ease", pointerEvents: on ? "auto" : "none" }}>

            <div className="hb-intro-grid" />

            <div className="hb-intro-sweep" />

            <div className="hb-intro-tv">

              <div className="hb-intro-screen">

                <div className="hb-intro-logo font-hud">HB</div>

                <div className="hb-intro-bars">

                  {[0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].map((i) => <span key={i} style={{ animationDelay: (i * 0.12) + "s" }} />)}

                </div>

                <div className="hb-intro-scan" />

              </div>

            </div>

            <div style={{ textAlign: "center" }}>

              <div className="hb-intro-title font-hud">HOMEM BRUTO</div>

              {status === "erro" ? (

                <div>

                  <div className="hb-intro-sub font-mono" style={{ color: "#FCA5A5" }}>SEM CONEXÃO COM OS CANAIS</div>

                  <button type="button" onClick={onRetry} className="font-mono" style={{ marginTop: 14, height: 38, padding: "0 18px", borderRadius: 999, border: "1px solid #22D3EE", background: "rgba(34,211,238,0.14)", color: "#A5F3FC", fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 800, letterSpacing: "0.08em", cursor: "pointer" }}>TENTAR DE NOVO</button>

                </div>

              ) : <div className="hb-intro-sub font-mono">SINTONIZANDO OS CANAIS<span className="hb-dots"><i>.</i><i>.</i><i>.</i></span></div>}

            </div>

            <div className="hb-intro-load"><span /></div>

          </div>

      );

    }

    function App() {

      const [chData, setChData] = useState(null);

      const [adsData, setAdsData] = useState([]);

      const [adsLoading, setAdsLoading] = useState(true);

      const [chatTxt, setChatTxt] = useState("");

      const [status, setStatus] = useState("carregando");

      const [minOk, setMinOk] = useState(false);

      const [tryN, setTryN] = useState(0);

      useEffect(() => { const t = setTimeout(() => setMinOk(true), 1800); return () => clearTimeout(t); }, []);

      useEffect(() => {

        let off = false;

        setStatus("carregando");

        // insiste sozinho: se uma tentativa falhar (rede, servidor, resposta cortada), tenta de novo, sem o visitante precisar de F5

        const get = async (name, tries, quick) => {

          for (let i = 0; i < tries; i++) {

            if (off) return null;

            try {

              const r = await fetch(DATA_URL + name + "?v=" + Date.now() + "_" + i, { cache: "no-store" });

              if (r.ok) return await r.json();

              if (quick && r.status === 404) return null;

              console.warn("[TV]", name, "HTTP", r.status, "tentativa", i + 1);

            } catch (e) {

              console.warn("[TV]", name, "falhou", e && e.message, "tentativa", i + 1);

            }

            await new Promise((res) => setTimeout(res, 1200 * (i + 1)));

          }

          return null;

        };

        const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (!off) setStatus((st) => (st === "carregando" ? "erro" : st)); }, 15000);

        // os canais (leve) aparecem primeiro; o catálogo (pesado) entra depois sem travar a TV

        get("canais.json", 5).then((pc) => {

          if (off) return;

          const chs = Array.isArray(pc) ? pc.filter((c) => c && c.id && !String(c.id).startsWith("CAT_")) : [];

          if (chs.length) { clearTimeout(timer); setChData(chs); setStatus("ok"); }

          else { clearTimeout(timer); setStatus("erro"); }

        });

        setAdsLoading(true);

        // Lab 24: primeiro o anuncios.json (leve, so links); se nao existir ou vier vazio, usa o catalogo.json antigo

        get("anuncios.json", 2, true).then((pl) => {

          if (off) return;

          let la = []; try { la = pl ? linksToAds(pl) : []; } catch (e) {}

          if (la.length) { setAdsData(la); setAdsLoading(false); return; }

          get("catalogo.json", 7).then((pk) => {

            if (off) return;

            try { const a = pk ? catalogToAds(pk) : []; if (a.length) setAdsData(a); } catch (e) {}

            setAdsLoading(false);

          });

        });

        // chat (texto simples): se não existir ou falhar, o site segue sem ele

        (async () => {

          for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {

            if (off) return;

            try {

              const r = await fetch(DATA_URL + "chat.txt?v=" + Date.now() + "_" + i, { cache: "no-store" });

              if (r.ok) { const t = await r.text(); if (!off) setChatTxt(t); return; }

              if (r.status === 404) return;

            } catch (e) {}

            await new Promise((res) => setTimeout(res, 1200 * (i + 1)));

          }

        })();

        return () => { off = true; clearTimeout(timer); };

      }, [tryN]);

      return (

        <>

          {chData ? <AppInner initCh={chData} adsPub={adsData} adsLoading={adsLoading} chatTxt={chatTxt} /> : null}

          <IntroScreen on={!(chData && minOk)} status={status} onRetry={() => setTryN((n) => n + 1)} />

        </>

      );

    }

    ReactDOM.render(<App />, document.getElementById('root'));

  </script>

</body>

</html>
